About the role and team
Core Build is Uber’s centralized build platform team. We develop and operate shared build infrastructure across Uber’s monorepos, including Bazel, build rules, dependency tooling, client-side remote caching and execution, and build/test CI pipelines. Our goal is to make builds fast, reliable, and easy to diagnose for engineers and AI coding agents.
We work across three pillars:
Velocity: Reduce build and test feedback times and infrastructure costs through caching, remote execution, parallelism, and build-graph optimization.
Reliability and diagnosability: Improve build success rates, reduce flakiness, and give developers clear feedback when something fails.
Modernization and scale: Modernize toolchains, expand shared infrastructure, and improve test selection and automated diagnosis.
Every change to Uber’s Web applications depends on fast, reliable builds and tests. As a Senior Software Engineer on Core Build, you will help migrate Uber’s Web monorepo from its current Jazelle/Yarn setup to native Bazel, enable remote build caching and execution, and operate the build and CI systems that Web engineers depend on.
You will own major projects across build rules, dependency management, toolchains, and CI. Working closely with Web Platform and CI Platform, you will improve developer feedback times, build reliability, and infrastructure efficiency—and help prepare Web builds for the growing demands of AI-assisted development and the software factory.
What you’ll do
Migrate the Web monorepo to native Bazel, including JavaScript/TypeScript build and test rules, toolchains, and third-party dependency management.
Make builds reproducible and hermetic to enable correct remote build caching and remote execution.
Improve local and CI performance through caching, parallelism, build-graph optimization, and efficient test sharding.
Partner with Web Platform to preserve developer workflows and roll out the migration incrementally with validation and rollback plans.
Improve consistency between local and CI results across builds, tests, lint, type checking, and visual regression checks.
Make failures easier to diagnose through actionable feedback, build telemetry, and systematic reduction of infrastructure failures and test flakiness.
Own Web build reliability alongside the team: define and track SLOs, participate in the Core Build oncall rotation, respond to incidents, and address recurring problems.
Drive Bazel and Web toolchain upgrades, contribute design docs, mentor engineers, and collaborate across teams on shared build infrastructure.
Basic Qualifications
5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years working on build systems, CI/CD, or developer tooling.
Strong TypeScript and Node.js experience, including debugging and profiling Node processes and build tooling.
Working knowledge of the modern JavaScript toolchain (pnpm/Yarn/npm, Vite, Rspack/webpack, esbuild or similar bundlers) and at least one major web framework, ideally React.
Hands-on experience with a large-scale build system in a monorepo (Bazel, Buck2, Pants, Nx, Turborepo, or similar), including diagnosing slow, flaky, or non-hermetic builds.
Experience building and running CI/CD pipelines (Buildkite, GitHub Actions, or similar) with reproducible, containerized builds from development through production.
A track record of leading technical initiatives that affected many engineers or services.
Preferred Qualifications
6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years working on build systems, CI/CD, or developer tooling.
Experience writing Bazel rules or extensions, or operating remote caching or remote execution.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and service-oriented or distributed systems.
Experience with modern web testing, such as cross-browser, integration, and visual regression testing (e.g., Playwright, Vitest).
Familiarity with web security fundamentals (CORS, CSP, CSRF, XSS) and software supply chain security (dependency auditing, provenance, lockfile integrity).
Experience with GraphQL, gRPC, WebSockets, or Server-Sent Events.
Experience building tooling that supports AI-assisted development workflows.
Open source contributions or maintainership.

uber-304160.text:
About the Role
Every service at Uber relies on the service mesh to find, reach, and trust the services it depends on, and the 1M+ concurrent trips Uber supports depend on it. The Service Mesh team builds and operates this layer across Uber's global infrastructure, where every millisecond the mesh adds contributes to the critical path of user-facing requests, efficiency gains translate directly into compute capacity, and every change must be designed to roll out safely.
As a Staff Software Engineer on the team, you will set technical direction for the proxy and networking infrastructure that carries Uber's service-to-service traffic. You will own problems end to end, from design through production rollout and long-term operation, working across Uber's security, network, compute, and storage stacks and with the product engineering teams whose services run on the mesh.
What You'll Do
Define the multi-quarter technical roadmap for the service mesh forwarding layer, including how core components of a live system evolve incrementally while traffic keeps flowing.
Drive down the latency and compute cost of the forwarding path, from proxy performance to smarter load balancing across hosts and zones, and roll out improvements safely.
Evolve the forwarding layer toward a horizontally scalable, compartmentalized architecture so routing state and failures stay contained as the mesh grows.
Strengthen service identity and authorization in the mesh without regressing tail latency.
Build observability that makes the mesh explainable, from request-level visibility to clear signals for service owners and on-call engineers.
Partner with product engineering teams and the teams behind Uber's security, network, compute, and storage stacks to turn their needs into platform capabilities.
Lead through influence by writing design docs, setting standards, leading incident response and postmortems, mentoring engineers, and introducing automation, including AI-based workflows, where it reduces toil.
About the Team
The Service Mesh team routes and load balances traffic between all Uber services across on-premises data centers and multiple public clouds, providing discovery, overload protection, traffic shifting, and service identity on both proxied and peer-to-peer paths.
We follow a few core principles: failures stay contained, changes are staged, observed, and reversible, and efficiency gains fund new capabilities. Our direction is a single Envoy-based forwarding layer that runs natively on Kubernetes and aligns with open standards such as the Gateway API.
The Service Mesh team is part of the Platform Engineering Team (PET), which includes Compute, Network, Storage, Reliability and Hardware Engineering, Corporate IT, and more. PET's mission is to "Empower One Uber to innovate by building a world-class foundation that accelerates growth at scale."
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of software engineering experience.
Proficiency in one or more of Go, C++, or Java.
Experience building and operating large-scale, latency-sensitive distributed systems or infrastructure in production.
Experience leading multi-team engineering projects through their full lifecycle, working across infrastructure and product teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Strong working knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP/2, gRPC, and TLS, as well as load balancing and traffic management.
Experience with proxies or service mesh technologies such as Envoy, and with Kubernetes networking.
Experience with service identity, authentication, and authorization, such as mTLS and SPIFFE.
Experience with safe change management for critical infrastructure, including staged rollouts, backward compatibility, rollback, and incremental migrations that keep old and new paths interoperable.
Contributions to open-source projects such as Envoy or gRPC.
A track record of mentoring engineers and raising the hiring bar.

About the Role
The Application Developer, ServiceNow Platform is responsible for designing, developing, configuring, and supporting scalable ServiceNow solutions that meet complex business and operational requirements. Working closely with product owners, business analysts, and architects, this role delivers high-quality solutions across ITSM, CMDB, Now Assist, and core platform capabilities , following ServiceNow development standards and best practices.
We are seeking a ServiceNow Developer with 6+ years of hands-on experience to build, enhance, and maintain the platform, leveraging Now Assist and generative AI capabilities to automate workflows, improve agent efficiency, and enable intelligent self-service. The role contributes to platform maturity through disciplined release management, reusable development patterns, and secure, API-driven integrations, while ensuring the ServiceNow platform remains stable, performant, compliant, and well-integrated within Uber’s broader technical ecosystem.
What the Candidate Will Need / Bonus Points
Platform Strategy: Evaluate business and technical requirements against ServiceNow platform capabilities and best practices, and design and deliver scalable ServiceNow solutions aligned to business needs, focusing on ITSM, workflow automation, integrations, and user experience
CI/CD & Platform DevOps: Design, implement, and support CI/CD pipelines for the ServiceNow platform, including source control integration, automated testing, update set and application lifecycle management, and promotion across environments in alignment with SDLC and governance standards.
Citizen Development & Governance: Enable and govern citizen development on the ServiceNow platform by establishing guardrails, reusable components, standards, and best practices, while mentoring non-professional developers to safely build workflows, apps, and automations without compromising platform integrity or performance
CMDB & Discovery: Manage CMDB health and data integrity by implementing Discovery Patterns, Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE) rules, and modeling relationships for Business Applications and Services
Now Assist & Automation: Integrate and configure Now Assist features — including AI-assisted workflows, chat summarization, and virtual agent enhancements.
Integrations: Build and maintain seamless integrations between ServiceNow and external systems (e.g., JIRA, Workday, Monitoring tools) using REST/SOAP web services and Flow Designer
Support & Troubleshooting: Provide ongoing support, troubleshooting, and training to end users, ensuring a user-friendly experience. Respond promptly to platform related issues and requests.
Continuous Improvement: Suggest and implement best practices for ServiceNow. Proactively identify areas for improvement and apply solutions to increase efficiency and productivity.
Documentation: Maintain clear, structured documentation of configurations, workflows, and processes to ensure consistent knowledge sharing and compliance.
Communication: Clear communicator with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively with the Business Analyst.
---- Basic Qualifications ----
6+ years of experience as a ServiceNow Developer/Engineer working on enterprise-scale ServiceNow implementations.
Demonstrated ability to assess and enforce architectural governance, standards, and technical best practices with strong expertise in JavaScript, Glide API, HTML, CSS, AJAX , and ServiceNow scripting (Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, and Script Includes)
Hands-on experience with Now Assist technologies — generative AI workflows and skill kits on the Now Platform.
Deep understanding of ITSM modules (Incident, Request) and solid experience with CMDB configuration, including CSDM standards and asset management processes
Proven experience implementing CI/CD practices for ServiceNow , including source control, automated testing, update set and application lifecycle management, and environment promotion strategies
Experience supporting and governing citizen development on the ServiceNow platform, including establishing guardrails, standards, and reusable components to enable low-code/no-code development safely
Proven experience designing and implementing complex integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and Flow Designer
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator ( CSA ) and Certified Application Developer ( CAD ) are required
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills , with a focus on finding pragmatic and effective solutions to complex technical challenges.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated ability to use AI-assisted tools (e.g., GenAI, workflow automation, analytics assistants) to accelerate program planning, requirements definition, risk analysis, documentation, and stakeholder communication in a production environment.
---- Preferred Qualifications ----
Preferred Qualifications
6+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions across ITSM, CMDB, workflow automation, and core platform capabilities , with strong adherence to architectural and development best practices.
Proven expertise in ServiceNow scripting and platform engineering (JavaScript, Glide API, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI components) with the ability to design scalable, maintainable solutions.
Demonstrated experience implementing CI/CD and DevOps practices for ServiceNow , including source control, automated testing, update set/application lifecycle management, and environment promotion.
Hands-on experience with Now Assist and generative AI features to enable intelligent automation, self-service, and agent productivity.

About Uber Engineering
Uber Engineering is a high-performance culture marked by perseverance and hyper-productivity. We’re looking for team players with natural customer service intuition who can work harder, faster, and smarter while taking technical excellence to a whole new level. You should be passionate about building a global transportation marketplace that spans a wide range of cities—varying from 100,000 to 10 million people in size—each with unique regulatory, technical, and business requirements.
About the Role
Uber Engineering operates in a fast-paced environment driven by scale, reliability, and speed. We’re looking for an Enterprise Application Developer who thrives at the intersection of IT, SaaS administration, automation, and customer impact.
This role owns the operational health, configuration, and lifecycle of Uber’s core enterprise applications while acting as the highest escalation point for complex application issues. You will partner closely with Engineering, Security, IT Operations, and Business stakeholders to ensure Uber’s critical collaboration and productivity platforms run securely, efficiently, and at a global scale.
This is not a traditional service desk role; it is a hands-on application ownership position with real influence over tooling, processes, and the user experience across all of Uber.
What You’ll Be Doing:
Application Ownership: Act as the primary technical owner for enterprise SaaS applications, including (but not limited to): Google Workspace, Zoom, Slack, Figma, Asana, Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, and Okta/Identity-integrated applications.
Lifecycle & Configuration: Manage application configuration, access models, permissions, integrations, and automation. Own the full application lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, renewals, vendor coordination, and feature rollouts.
Escalation & Incident Management: Serve as a Super Admin with the highest level of system access. Resolve complex, escalated Tier 3 application issues beyond standard troubleshooting and lead incident responses for enterprise application outages or degradations.
Automation & Integration: Design and implement automation and integration workflows using JavaScript, Python, APIs, and Enterprise AI applications (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, MCP) to reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
Data Analysis: Analyze ticket and usage data to identify trends, systemic issues, and opportunities for optimization. Leverage strong programming and database skills (BigQuery, Apache Hive) to drive these insights.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the crucial bridge between IT Engineering, the Service Desk, Security, and Business stakeholders. Provide actionable feedback to IT Engineering leadership regarding application pain points and improvement opportunities.
Documentation & Compliance: Own and maintain internal and external-facing documentation, including runbooks, SOPs, and escalation guides. Ensure procurement and licensing processes adhere to logistics and compliance guidelines.
General Support: Perform additional duties as assigned to support seamless enterprise application operations.
Basic Qualifications:
3+ years of IT or Enterprise Application Development experience.
3+ years of experience supporting SaaS platforms at scale with admin-level access.
Strong scripting or coding skills (Python, Bash, APIs).
Solid understanding of Enterprise AI applications, including Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Familiarity with identity and access management concepts (Okta, AD, SSO, SCIM).
Proven experience acting as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
Strong documentation, training, and communication skills.
Ability to respond quickly to incidents and operate effectively in high-pressure situations.
Willingness to participate in on-call rotations and work outside standard business hours when needed.
Preferred Qualifications:
4+ years of experience in Enterprise Application Development or Software Engineering.
Demonstrated expertise in building and deploying automation using Python, JavaScript, and APIs.
Experience with data warehousing and querying large datasets (BigQuery, Hive).
Hands-on experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD tools.
Deep knowledge of Linux environments and cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS).
3-4+ years of experience driving process efficiency and providing Tier 3 support.
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Strong problem-solving, organizational, and project management skills.
A self-starter mentality with the ability to take initiative and work both independently and collaboratively.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Senior Software Engineer, Michelangelo Job Controller team
About the role and team
Leading at Uber means setting direction in motion, not waiting for perfect conditions. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Michelangelo Job Controller team, you will help build the compute infrastructure that runs ML workloads for hundreds of teams across Uber, from scheduling and launching Ray and other distributed jobs on Kubernetes to managing their lifecycle at scale. Our mission is to make transportation as reliable as running water, and we need strong engineers to build the dependable, high-performance foundation that supports that vision.
This is a role for a systems thinker who thrives in high-stakes environments. You will navigate the "messy" reality of complex infrastructure spanning global data centers and multiple cloud providers, supporting a wide variety of ML workloads. You will make smart decisions with imperfect information and own the outcomes of what you build. If you lead with clarity, build with heart, and are motivated by the challenge of reliability and efficiency at unparalleled scale, this is where you'll make your mark.
What you'll do
- Design and build the Job Controller, the Kubernetes-native system that manages the lifecycle of ML jobs, including submission, scheduling, execution, and cleanup.
- Build and improve the integration of Ray and Kubernetes, solving scaling, reliability, and resource utilization challenges for large training and processing workloads.
- Work on compute infrastructure problems such as job placement across clusters, resource pools, quota, and capacity efficiency.
- Drive reliability and observability for the controllers, including safe rollouts, failure handling, and well-defined SLOs.
- Use data-driven analysis to diagnose job failures, scheduling delays, and performance regressions, and to optimize resource utilization.
- Build tooling, APIs, and frameworks that increase the velocity and quality of hundreds of internal engineering and ML teams.
- Review code and designs, mentor other engineers, and foster a culture of continuous learning and humility.
- Work cross-functionally with ML, Product, Infrastructure, and Operations teams across the globe to drive projects and align technical investments with business value.
Basic Qualifications
- 6+ years of professional experience building scalable, fault-tolerant products or platforms, with a track record of solving important problems.
- Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Go, C/C++, Java, Python, or JavaScript).
- Deep understanding of Kubernetes and Ray, beyond using them as a user. This means knowing how they work internally and how to extend, operate, and debug them at scale.
- Experience with compute infrastructure, such as cluster management, job scheduling, or resource orchestration.
- Proven experience delivering large-scale engineering projects through the entire lifecycle from inception to production.
- Ability to make sound engineering and business tradeoffs.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience building Kubernetes controllers and operators (e.g., with controller-runtime or client-go).
- Experience with ML platforms, distributed training, or workflow orchestration systems.
- Experience operating Kubernetes or Ray across multiple clusters or regions.
- Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) with a focus on distributed computing, system performance, or machine learning.
- Experience contributing to open-source projects such as Kubernetes or Ray.

About the Role
The UberEats Feed Ranking team is responsible for the ML ranking layer which personalizes the Eats Homefeed. This personalization layer is one of the main drivers of order growth across the Delivery organization. As a Machine Learning Engineer (MLE) on the Feed Ranking team, you will own and develop models across our entire ranking stack (Retrieval + Pre-Ranking, Second Pass Ranking, Post-Ranking). Our models are sophisticated (>5B parameters), our features are rich (near-realtime engagement history with 1-year lookback), and our serving requirements are stringent (>10M QPS with low latency and high availability). As an MLE, the reward for working within these requirements is significant - offline performance gains in our ranking models are strongly correlated with topline impact for the entire Eats business.
What You’ll Do
Own and develop on all parts of the ML lifecycle - both offline (training, model architecture, etc.) and online (serving efficiency, GPU provisioning + utilization, etc.).
Bring SOTA ML techniques from DLRM and LLM literature (Scaling Laws, Kernel Fusion, Latent Attention, Agentic Auto-Research, RL-based post-ranking, etc.) into our modeling stack.
Collaborate closely with backend engineers to ensure high-quality and reliability in end-to-end integration.
Coordinate with Science and Product partners to maximize the business impact of ML improvements.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related field, with 3+ years of full-time experience working on production ML systems.
Strong proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Go, or Java.
Strong proficiency with common Deep-Learning frameworks (PyTorch, Tensorflow/Keras, Jax, etc.).
Experience with distributed data processing and ETL frameworks (Spark, Ray Data, etc.).
Strong technical communication and ability to manage multiple cross functional stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications
Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related field, with publications in the ML/AI space (papers, conference presentations, company technical blogs, etc.).
Industry experience working on Deep Learning Recommendation Systems and/or LLM model development at scale in a production/user-facing environment.
Experience optimizing Deep Learning model architectures + serving stack to improve GPU MFU across different hardware types.
Desire to grow into technical leadership and become a force multiplier for junior engineers.

About the role and team
Leading at Uber means setting direction in motion, not waiting for perfect conditions. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be a technical anchor for the Michelangelo Control Plane, the foundation that orchestrates the lifecycle of ML pipelines, training jobs, models, and deployments for hundreds of teams across Uber. Our mission is to make transportation as reliable as running water, and we need technical powerhouses to build the dependable, high-performance foundation that supports that vision.
This is a role for a proven, large-scale systems thinker who thrives in high-stakes environments. You will navigate the "messy" reality of complex infrastructure spanning global data centers and multiple cloud providers, supporting a wide variety of ML workloads. You will make smart decisions with imperfect information and own the outcomes of architectural choices that affect every ML workflow at Uber. If you lead with clarity, build with heart, and are motivated by the challenge of reliability and efficiency at unparalleled scale, this is where you'll make your mark.
What you'll do
- Own the architecture and technical roadmap of the Michelangelo control plane, including its API layer, Kubernetes-native resource model (CRDs and controllers), and state management on etcd and MySQL.
- Design and scale the control plane's storage and reconciliation layers, solving consistency, throughput, and latency challenges as the number of managed resources and clusters grows.
- Drive reliability, availability, and disaster recovery for the control plane, including multi-cluster and multi-region operation, safe upgrades, and well-defined SLOs.
- Provide deep technical mentorship across the stack, ensuring architecture and implementations are robust, extensible, and secure.
- Build tooling, APIs, and frameworks that increase the velocity and quality of hundreds of internal engineering and ML teams.
- Use observability and data-driven analysis to diagnose performance regressions, controller bottlenecks, and etcd or MySQL contention, and to optimize resource utilization.
- Review code and designs while fostering a culture of continuous learning and humility.
- Work cross-functionally with ML, Product, Infrastructure, and Operations teams across the globe to drive large-scale projects and align technical investments with business value.
Basic Qualifications
- 8+ years of professional experience building scalable, fault-tolerant products or platforms, with a track record of solving strategically important problems.
- Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Go, C/C++, Java, Python, or JavaScript) and the ability to define organization-wide standards.
- Deep expertise in Kubernetes internals, including the API server, custom resource definitions, controllers and operators, and admission webhooks.
- Strong experience with etcd and MySQL.
- Proven experience leading large-scale engineering projects through the entire lifecycle from inception to global productionization.
- Expertise in making complex engineering and business tradeoffs.
- Experience identifying architectural gaps and acting as a multiplier to reduce technical debt across the organization.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience building or operating ML platforms or workflow orchestration systems.
- Experience operating Kubernetes across multiple clusters or regions.

- Experience contributing to open-source projects or leading industry-level technical discussions.

Leading at Uber means setting technical direction and building foundational systems that operate at global scale. As a Sr Software Engineer on the Streaming Data Platform team, you will shape the architecture and evolution of the critical infrastructure that powers real-time data movement and processing across Uber's global marketplace.
Our streaming data platform serves as the backbone for real-time applications, analytics, and machine learning, enabling engineering teams to reliably produce, process, and consume massive volumes of data. The platform supports a diverse range of mission-critical workloads, where scalability, low latency, high availability, and operational efficiency are essential.
You will tackle some of the most challenging problems in large-scale distributed systems, from designing next-generation streaming architectures and improving fault tolerance to optimizing resource utilization and simplifying platform operations. Your work will directly influence the reliability, efficiency, and developer experience of foundational infrastructure used across Uber.
This role is for an accomplished technical leader who can navigate complex architectural tradeoffs, anticipate future scaling challenges, and drive transformative engineering initiatives across organizational boundaries. You will combine deep technical expertise with strategic thinking, influence long-term technology investments, and empower other engineers to deliver impactful solutions.
If you are passionate about solving hard distributed systems problems, pushing the boundaries of infrastructure performance, and building platforms that enable innovation at unprecedented scale, this is where you will make your mark.

Lead the design and evolution of large-scale distributed streaming systems, solving fundamental challenges in data delivery, distributed coordination, consistency, fault tolerance, resource management, and high availability.

Ability to mentor senior engineers, communicate complex technical concepts clearly, and raise the technical bar across an engineering organization.

Uber One serves as Uber's flagship membership program and stands as one of the company's core strategic growth engines. Boasting over 50 million members—a 55% surge year-over-year—the program drives 50% of Uber's total gross bookings. It plays a pivotal role in accelerating platform engagement, multi-product adoption, and sustained customer retention across Rides, Delivery, and Grocery.

Staff Software Engineer – Streaming Data Platform
About the role and team
Leading at Uber means setting technical direction and building foundational systems that operate at global scale. As a Staff Software Engineer on the Streaming Data Platform team, you will shape the architecture and evolution of the critical infrastructure that powers real-time data movement and processing across Uber's global marketplace.
Our streaming data platform serves as the backbone for real-time applications, analytics, and machine learning, enabling engineering teams to reliably produce, process, and consume massive volumes of data. The platform supports a diverse range of mission-critical workloads, where scalability, low latency, high availability, and operational efficiency are essential.
You will tackle some of the most challenging problems in large-scale distributed systems, from designing next-generation streaming architectures and improving fault tolerance to optimizing resource utilization and simplifying platform operations. Your work will directly influence the reliability, efficiency, and developer experience of foundational infrastructure used across Uber.
This role is for an accomplished technical leader who can navigate complex architectural tradeoffs, anticipate future scaling challenges, and drive transformative engineering initiatives across organizational boundaries. You will combine deep technical expertise with strategic thinking, influence long-term technology investments, and empower other engineers to deliver impactful solutions.
If you are passionate about solving hard distributed systems problems, pushing the boundaries of infrastructure performance, and building platforms that enable innovation at unprecedented scale, this is where you will make your mark.
What you'll do
Define and drive the technical vision and architecture for Uber's streaming data platform, ensuring its long-term scalability, reliability, performance, and extensibility as business and infrastructure requirements evolve.
Lead the design and evolution of large-scale distributed streaming systems, solving fundamental challenges in data delivery, distributed coordination, consistency, fault tolerance, resource management, and high availability.
Drive architectural innovation and modernization across streaming infrastructure, identifying opportunities to simplify complex systems, eliminate scalability bottlenecks, and improve overall platform efficiency.
Establish technical strategies for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency, leveraging deep systems expertise, benchmarking, and workload analysis to optimize compute, storage, memory, and network utilization.
Architect highly resilient, multi-tenant infrastructure that supports diverse workloads with demanding throughput, latency, durability, and availability requirements.
Build and champion foundational platform capabilities, including automation, observability, capacity management, and self-service tooling, that improve developer productivity and reduce operational complexity across engineering organizations.
Anticipate emerging technical challenges and opportunities, evaluating new technologies and architectural approaches to inform strategic investments and long-term platform roadmaps.
Provide technical leadership for complex, cross-organizational initiatives, driving alignment among stakeholders and ensuring successful execution from initial strategy through production adoption.
Establish engineering excellence and operational best practices for mission-critical infrastructure, including architecture reviews, reliability standards, incident prevention, and systematic root-cause analysis.
Mentor and elevate senior engineers, fostering technical depth, sound architectural judgment, and a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and engineering excellence.
Collaborate with infrastructure, storage, data engineering, and product engineering organizations to align platform capabilities with Uber's evolving real-time data needs and broader technical strategy.
Basic Qualifications
10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant expertise in designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems, infrastructure platforms, or data-intensive services.
Deep understanding of distributed systems principles, including consistency, replication, consensus, fault tolerance, concurrency, distributed coordination, and failure recovery.
Proven experience architecting high-performance, highly available systems that operate at significant scale with stringent throughput, latency, reliability, and durability requirements.
Strong proficiency in one or more systems or backend programming languages, such as Java, Go, C++, Scala, Python, or Rust, with demonstrated ability to design and implement complex production systems.
Experience with large-scale data infrastructure, distributed messaging systems, stream processing platforms, or related technologies, including the ability to reason about their architectural tradeoffs.
Demonstrated track record of providing technical leadership for complex, multi-team engineering initiatives, from architecture and technical strategy through implementation and production adoption.
Strong expertise in system performance analysis, scalability engineering, and troubleshooting complex distributed infrastructure under production workloads.
Proven ability to identify fundamental architectural challenges, evaluate alternative solutions, and make sound technical and business tradeoffs with long-term organizational impact.
Experience influencing technical direction, establishing engineering standards, and driving alignment across teams and organizational boundaries.
Ability to mentor senior engineers, communicate complex technical concepts clearly, and raise the technical bar across an engineering organization.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Deep experience architecting or developing large-scale streaming, messaging, or real-time data processing infrastructure using technologies such as Apache Kafka, Apache Pulsar, Apache Flink, Apache Spark, or equivalent distributed systems.
Expertise in the internals of distributed data systems, including partitioning, replication, log-based storage, metadata management, state management, backpressure, and end-to-end delivery guarantees.
Experience leading architectural evolution or significant modernization of foundational distributed infrastructure serving large numbers of applications and engineering teams.
Strong understanding of systems-level performance optimization, including Linux internals, multithreading, memory management, network protocols, storage I/O, and resource scheduling.
Experience designing multi-region or geographically distributed infrastructure, including cross-region data replication, disaster recovery, and availability strategies.
Expertise in building scalable multi-tenant platforms, including workload isolation, capacity management, resource allocation, and infrastructure cost optimization.
Experience with cloud-native infrastructure, container orchestration, and large-scale automation frameworks.
Familiarity with modern data architectures, including change data capture (CDC), event-driven systems, stream processing, real-time analytics, and data lake integration.
Experience designing or contributing to open-source distributed systems, infrastructure frameworks, or technologies adopted by the broader engineering community.
Demonstrated success in driving major architectural transformations, influencing organization-wide technology strategy, and balancing short-term delivery with long-term infrastructure investments.
Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Computer Science or a related field, with a focus on distributed computing, storage systems, or system performance.

About the Role
What we do
Delphi, Uber's Lever Efficiency team, builds the system Uber uses to recommend how to invest billions of dollars per year across its marketplace supply and demand levers: courier pricing (supply), courier incentives (supply), delivery and service fees (demand), user promotions (demand), etc. Starting with Uber's Delivery Marketplace business, we turn experiment results into a measure of each lever's incremental value in a common currency and publish it in a dashboard that refreshes automatically. We're also building a budget allocation tool that recommends how to move budget between levers. We work day to day with data scientists, product, operations, and finance.
Why it matters
Today each lever spends against its own budget target, even after it starts hitting diminishing returns. A trusted, comparable measure of what each lever returns lets Uber move money to where it does the most good: more reliable deliveries for customers, more earning opportunities for couriers, and more long-term growth for every dollar spent. The hard part is making the numbers trustworthy enough that Operations and Finance leaders act on them. Then the recommendations have to be proven with well-designed experiments. That's the system you'll help build.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent experience in an engineering related bootcamp
2+ years of experience in professional software development experience, developing and deploying systems in production environments
Proven skills writing efficient, clean code in Go, Java, or Python
Ability to debug and fix software bugs in a production scale environment
Experience with software engineering best practices
Strong grasp of distributed-systems fundamentals: caching, sharding, consensus, fault tolerance, observability, and incident response
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document architectures and algorithms
Preferred Qualifications
Advanced coursework or industry background in statistics, causal inference, or experimental design.
Direct ownership of analysis workflows (A/B, quasi-experimental, marketplace simulations) at scale.
Python, Pandas, PySpark
Data Pipelines (e.g. Spark, Scala)
Jupyter Notebooks
Fullstack development experience (BE, FE, Data Pipelines), this project involves a full suite of development surfaces across UI, backend, and data.
Experience developing internal tooling used by Ops, Engineers, Finance, Scientists, etc.
What the Candidate Will Do
Build and own data pipelines (Spark, Hive, scheduled workflows) that recompute lever-efficiency estimates from experiment and marketplace data every week. Include data-quality checks, freshness alerts and backfills.
Build backend services and APIs in Go that store and serve efficiency estimates and budget recommendations.
Ship full-stack features in the web app: interactive dashboards and a budget allocation tool used by Operations, Finance, Product, and Science.
Work with data scientists to turn notebook prototypes into production code. This includes confidence intervals, corrections for network effects, forecasts, and an optimizer that moves budget between levers within real constraints, such as fixed total spend and capped weekly changes.
Work with Uber's experimentation platform to run experiments that test budget moves (switchbacks, geo experiments, synthetic control), and automate reading their results into the dashboard.
Take features from design to launch: write design docs, review code, test, monitor production, and take part in on-call.
Document methodology and system design so partners can trust and reuse the numbers.

Virtually all Engineers, Scientists, and Product Managers at the company use our platform on a daily basis to launch, monitor, test, and make changes to Uber’s ecosystem.

Velocity with Confidence : By automating experiment design, rollout, and analysis, we reduce the cost of iteration and let teams validate the impact of features our members love.
Company Wide Reach : Virtually every engineer, data scientist, and product manager touches our platform daily to launch, monitor, and refine Uber’s ecosystem.
Business Impact at Scale : Decisions backed by our tooling safeguard core metrics while empowering innovators to push boundaries.

Be responsible for the design, implementation, and delivery of complex projects
Build highly reliable and resilient features in our iOS Mobile SDK
Collaborate with cross-functional mobile developer teams to enable and support the business
Identify and fix bugs and reliability of current systems
Bring in your passionate self and positively impact the team around you

Objective C programming

Senior Software Engineer
About the Role
We are seeking talented Senior Software Engineers to join our Search Engineering team and help build the next generation of AI-powered search experiences.
In this role, you will design and build large-scale backend and model-serving infrastructure that powers search retrieval, ranking, personalization, and emerging LLM-based search experiences. You will work on systems that operate at high request volumes with strict latency and reliability requirements, spanning traditional search infrastructure, machine learning model serving, and modern LLM inference.
You will collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers, data scientists, product managers, and platform teams to evolve the search stack toward more intelligent, real-time, and AI-native architectures. This includes integrating LLM-based ranking and retrieval, optimizing GPU inference and serving efficiency, incorporating real-time marketplace signals, and building scalable infrastructure that enables rapid experimentation while maintaining production-grade performance and reliability.
Basic Qualifications
5+ years of professional software engineering experience building large-scale backend or distributed systems.
Strong programming skills in Go, Java, C++, Python, or a similar language.
Strong understanding of distributed systems, service-oriented architectures, concurrency, networking, caching, and data consistency.
Experience building high-throughput, low-latency online serving systems.
Experience with search, recommendation, ranking, machine learning serving, or other large-scale data-intensive systems.
Experience diagnosing and optimizing system performance across latency, throughput, reliability, and infrastructure efficiency.
Familiarity with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Spark, or similar frameworks.
Experience operating production systems, including observability, monitoring, capacity planning, incident response, and reliability engineering.
Strong system design, problem-solving, and analytical skills with the ability to work across multiple layers of a complex production stack.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience building search and recommendation systems, including retrieval, ranking, query understanding, indexing, and personalization.
Hands-on experience with search technologies such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Solr, Vespa, Lucene, or large-scale proprietary search systems.
Experience with LLM or ML model-serving infrastructure, including frameworks such as vLLM, Triton, or similar inference platforms.
Experience optimizing GPU-based inference workloads, including batching or micro-batching, request scheduling, model parallelism, memory management, and GPU utilization.
Familiarity with LLM serving concepts such as prefill/decode, KV caching, prefix caching, streaming generation, speculative techniques, and distributed inference.
Experience with embeddings, semantic retrieval, approximate nearest-neighbor search, semantic IDs, or generative retrieval.
Familiarity with constrained decoding or integrating real-time business and marketplace constraints into AI-powered serving systems.
Experience integrating near-real-time features and signals into latency-sensitive ranking or inference systems.
Experience designing ML/LLM systems with strong reliability, graceful degradation, experimentation, and launch-safety mechanisms.
What the Candidate Will Do
Design and build highly scalable search and AI serving infrastructure with a focus on latency, throughput, reliability, and infrastructure efficiency.
Develop the backend architecture for next-generation AI-powered search, including LLM-based retrieval, ranking, personalization, and generative search experiences.
Integrate large language models and machine learning models into production search serving paths while meeting stringent latency and reliability requirements.
Optimize GPU inference and model-serving performance through techniques such as batching, micro-batching, request routing, caching, streaming, and efficient resource utilization.
Build infrastructure for advanced LLM-serving patterns such as context prefill, KV/prefix-cache reuse, progressive or streaming generation, and efficient multi-turn or paginated search experiences.
Develop scalable retrieval and ranking systems spanning lexical retrieval, semantic retrieval, embeddings, structured signals, and ML/LLM-based ranking.
Work on semantic-ID and constrained-decoding infrastructure that allows generative models to interact safely and efficiently with large-scale search catalogs and real-time marketplace signals.
Build and optimize real-time feature retrieval, hydration, caching, and data-processing systems that provide fresh signals to ranking and LLM models.
Partner closely with ML engineers and data scientists to productionize new ranking and relevance models, improve experimentation velocity, and shorten the path from model development to production.
Continuously improve end-to-end search performance by identifying bottlenecks across retrieval, feature serving, model inference, orchestration, networking, and presentation hydration.
Design systems for graceful degradation, observability, capacity management, experimentation, and safe production rollouts of new AI and search capabilities.
Analyze production and experiment metrics to understand latency, relevance, reliability, and business trade-offs and use those insights to guide system architecture.
Contribute to the long-term technical architecture of the Search platform as it evolves from traditional multi-stage retrieval and ranking toward increasingly unified, AI-native search systems.
Write high-quality, maintainable production code and provide technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and cross-team collaboration.
Troubleshoot complex production issues across distributed search and AI-serving systems and drive improvements that prevent recurrence.

Engineering at Uber means building for real-world impact under real-world constraints. The problems are complex, the systems are massive, and the pace is fast. You'll need to make smart decisions with imperfect information and own them. If you think in systems, thrive in ambiguous, high-stakes environments, and care about building things that actually work, this is where you'll grow.
Core Services Production Engineering is a software engineering team, not a traditional operations or systems administration team. We solve reliability problems by writing code—building chaos testing tools, traffic engineering and dependency safety frameworks, automation tools, and observability primitives.
As a Production Engineer, you will blend multiple domains of software engineering to ensure Uber's services run reliably at massive scale, while improving compute efficiency and accelerating developer productivity across a platform that serves millions of users around the world.
Our main focus areas include:
Chaos testing tools and applications
Dependency safety frameworks and tooling
Observability and alerting platforms
Graceful degradation

Design, build, and maintain software that improves the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of thousands of stateless and stateful production services distributed across multiple data center zones and regions.

About the Role:
Engages with stakeholders across teams to lead the design, development, and evolution of the build systems and CI infrastructure that every Android engineer at Uber depends on.
Every change to Uber's Android apps — Rider, Driver, Uber Eats, and more — flows through the build. In this role, you will own the Android build end to end: the Bazel build graph and rules, remote caching, and the CI pipelines that verify every change before it lands. You will set the technical direction for making Android builds faster, more reliable, and more cost-efficient at monorepo scale, and lead cross-team initiatives to achieve these goals.
What You'll Do:
Own the Android build end to end — the Bazel build graph, Starlark rules and toolchains (Android, Kotlin, Java), and dependency management across a large, multi-app Android monorepo.
Drive down CI and local build latency through remote build caching and remote execution, build-graph pruning, critical-path parallelism, and cost-aware CI sharding.
Make local and CI results consistent, so a green local build, test, or lint result means a green CI run.
Make every build failure actionable: eliminate flakiness and cache-correctness issues, add per-target telemetry and smarter retry policies, and ensure engineers and AI coding agents know what failed, how to fix it, and who to contact.
Keep the Android build modern: lead Bazel upgrades, Kotlin and Android toolchain upgrades, and dependency-automation (Gazelle) rollouts as coordinated, low-disruption initiatives.
Shrink the workload, not just speed it up: partner on smart test selection over the shared Bazel graph so each change runs only the tests it can affect, without sacrificing quality.
Define and track build health — latency, success rate, cache hit rate, and flakiness — and catch regressions before developers feel them.
Lead through influence: write design documents, set standards, mentor engineers, lead build incident response, and partner with Android Platform, CI Platform, and product teams to deliver improvements across the organization.
About the Team:
Core Build is Uber's centralized build platform team. We own the common build infrastructure — Bazel, Gazelle, build rules, client-side remote build caching and execution, and shared build/test CI pipelines — across Uber's Java, Go, Android, iOS, and Web monorepos.
Our vision is simple: make builds fast with less friction. Because the stack is shared, an improvement we make once benefits every engineer at Uber.
We work across three pillars:
Velocity: Make builds faster everywhere with fewer resources — in CI, remote development environments, and on laptops — through caching, remote execution, sharding, and build-graph optimization.
Reliability & Diagnosability: A build failure should never leave an engineer stranded. Every failure should communicate what failed, how to fix it, and who can help.
Modernization, Unification & Scale: Keep the platform on the latest Bazel, maximize CI fleet utilization with smart test selection and build-graph pruning, and apply GenAI/ML to automate diagnosis and optimization.
Our next major initiative is to stop compiling the same code thousands of times: make mobile builds remote-first, so a local build becomes a download rather than a compile, and run only the tests a change can actually affect.
As the Staff Android Engineer on the team, you will be the technical owner for the Android side of this roadmap.
Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of full-time engineering experience.
Systematic problem-solving approach and knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and complexity analysis.
Strong understanding of Android development.
Preferred Technical Skills:
Deep, hands-on experience with Bazel (or Buck) for Android builds: Starlark rules, rules_android / rules_kotlin, build-graph and dependency management.
Remote build caching and remote execution (Remote Execution API; e.g., Buildbarn, BuildBuddy, EngFlow).
Android build internals: Gradle, D8/R8, resource processing, and Kotlin compiler / annotation-processing performance.
CI systems at scale (e.g., Buildkite): sharding, test orchestration, and flaky-test management.
Build performance analysis and observability (Bazel profiles, Build Event Protocol, metrics, and regression dashboards).
Leading large-scale build migrations or upgrades (e.g., Buck/Gradle to Bazel, Bazel major versions, bzlmod).
Tooling development in Kotlin/Java.
Applying LLMs/AI agents to developer tooling (e.g., automated build-failure diagnosis).
Cross-platform experience (Android and iOS).

As a Staff Software Engineer on Uber's AI Foundations & Developer Experience (AIFX) team, you will set technical direction across multiple AIFX projects and lead efforts that reach engineering teams across Uber. You'll help define how AI agents plan, build, review, verify, and ship software at Uber, and turn that vision into platforms thousands of engineers depend on. You'll make long-term architectural bets in a space where models and agent harnesses change month to month, while keeping today's systems reliable.
About the Team
Uber's AI Foundations & Developer Experience (AIFX) team, part of Developer Platform, is a centralized, cross-monorepo team building the next generation of agentic AI systems for Uber's engineers. We design and run in-house developer agents and AI-first tooling, and we integrate them deeply across Uber's monorepos (Go, Java, Python, web, and mobile) and its engineering ecosystem. Our goal: help teams across the company ship code at scale with more speed, better quality, and less toil .
What we own today:
AIFX CLI & agent harness layer: a single way for engineers to install, configure, and run AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and others) with consistent settings, plugins, skills, and MCP servers across laptops, devpods, and CI.
Background coding agents (Minion): a platform that runs autonomous coding tasks at scale, from bug fixes and migrations to CI repair, and turns them into reviewable pull requests.
AI code review (uReview): LLM-powered review on code changes across Uber's monorepos, with team-level customization.
Agent governance & cost controls: model routing, spend caps, usage analytics, and evaluation, so that AI adoption stays reliable, secure, and cost-efficient.
We work closely with Developer Platform partners (CI, Submit Queue, DevPod, IDE), Michelangelo (ML platform), Security, and product engineering teams. We also work with frontier model providers. Our team has presented its work externally at multiple conferences, including at DPE Summit.
What the Candidate Will Do
Set technical direction for the AIFX software factory : lead the evolution of a software factory where durable, multi-day agent workflows orchestrate planning, coding, review, and verification to turn a spec into a verified, landable change.
Define the future of AI in Uber's SDLC : drive the long-term vision for how engineering at Uber works with AI agents, from planning and coding to review, verification, and release, and align Developer Platform and Engineering leadership behind it.
Shape the wider Uber AI ecosystem : partner with platform and product engineering orgs across Uber so AI agents work across every codebase and workflow, and set the standards other teams build on.
Lead the hardest problems hands-on : prototype, design, and ship critical components, and set the bar for evaluation, reliability, and cost across AIFX systems.
Grow technical leaders : mentor senior engineers and tech leads, run design reviews, and represent Uber's AI developer platform with industry partners, model providers, and the external engineering community.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including building and operating large-scale backend services or developer platforms in production.
Proficiency in at least one major programming language (e.g., Go, Java, Python, or TypeScript).
Experience setting technical direction for multi-team or org-wide projects through all stages: inception, stakeholder alignment, implementation, and operations.
Preferred Qualifications
Track record of shipping LLM-powered agents or developer tools to production at scale, and of defining how they are evaluated (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, online experiments).
Deep experience with agent harnesses and protocols (Claude Code / Claude Agent SDK, Codex, OpenCode, MCP) and with workflow orchestration or durable execution systems (e.g., Cadence, Temporal).
Experience defining multi-year technical strategy for developer infrastructure (build, CI/CD, code review, large monorepos) and earning buy-in across orgs and leadership.
Recognized technical leadership beyond your team: mentoring senior engineers and representing your org in the broader technical community (talks, open source, publications).

About the Role
As a Staff Engineer in Core Infrastructure, you will be a key technical leader driving the architecture and evolution of the systems that power Uber’s global business. You will engage with stakeholders across the company to spearhead backend solutions supporting every trip, delivery, and infrastructure tool used at Uber.
We are building a "cloud-native by default" ecosystem that is secure, reliable, and hyperscale-efficient. In this role, you will own the technical roadmap for critical sub-systems, ensuring our infrastructure is prepared to handle 1M+ concurrent trips alongside the massive compute demands of Generative AI and Autonomous Vehicle data.
About the Team
The Core Infrastructure Platform team builds the next generation of Uber’s orchestration, foundation, and networking layers. We manage a highly complex fleet spanning on-prem data centers and multiple public clouds, supporting a diverse variety of workloads including stateless, batch, streaming, and ML.
Our ultimate goal is to create seamless abstractions so Uber developers can deploy anywhere in the world with the touch of a button—making infrastructure "just work." We are also highly active contributors to the open-source community (Kubernetes, CNCF) and regularly present our innovations at industry conferences like KubeCon.
What You Will Do
Lead Architectural Evolution: Identify architectural gaps in our compute and networking stacks. Lead projects from ideation to global execution to fill those gaps (e.g., migrating to standardized CNI/Envoy or implementing shared GPU pools).
Drive Efficiency at Scale: Design and implement solutions to increase fleet-wide CPU utilization (targeting 40%+) and accelerate ARM adoption to aggressively optimize Uber’s unit costs.
Modernize for Multi-Cloud: Direct the technical strategy for our "Thrive in Cloud" initiative, ensuring our foundations are resilient, active-active across providers, and capable of rapid regional failover.
Integrate AIOps & Automation: Drive the development of "Agentic" infrastructure tools (e.g., Project Eve for network quality) to automate 80% of alert triaging and incident response.
Champion "Security by Design": Ensure 100% service-to-service authorization and zero-trust networking are baked into the core fabric of our container and networking platforms.
Drive Cross-Functional Impact: Collaborate heavily with Storage, Data, and Product teams to ensure the infrastructure can support 300x larger ranking models and L4 Autonomous Vehicle data ingestion.
Mentor & Scale Talent: Act as a force multiplier by mentoring 5A and mid-level engineers, fostering a culture of "100% Done-Done" and operational excellence across the organization.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a closely related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
8+ years of full-time Software Engineering work experience (inclusive of PhD research or equivalent specialized education).
Systems Languages: Deep, hands-on proficiency in Go, Java, or C++.
Distributed Systems Mastery: Demonstrated experience designing, building, and productionizing large-scale, high-availability infrastructure services.
Execution Excellence: A proven track record of leading complex, multi-quarter technical initiatives from initial design through fleet-wide rollout.
Preferred Qualifications
Cloud-Native Depth: Deep knowledge of Kubernetes internals, container runtimes (CRI), and modern networking (CNI/Envoy).
Infrastructure Strategy: Prior experience with hybrid-cloud or multi-cloud migrations and cost-optimization at a massive scale.
Linux & Kernel Knowledge: Strong understanding of operating systems, Linux kernel performance tuning, and/or eBPF.
AI/ML Infrastructure: Experience building or managing compute platforms specifically tailored for GPU scheduling and large-scale model training.
Community Influence: Active contributions to open-source infrastructure projects or a history of presenting at major technical conferences.

The Marketplace Fares Team powers global fares for all of Uber - that’s all riders, drivers, eaters, new initiatives and technical consumers. Tens of billions of dollars in gross bookings flow through the systems and experiences within our responsibility. Our scope and critical work spans the entire stack - from platform fare calculation for riders and drivers, to data science prediction of trustworthy upfront prices, to compelling mobile fare experiences for our customers. Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We're building out a high-velocity team of multi-disciplinary experts to turn real-world operations into high-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team is focused on the hardest problem in AV today: unlocking real-world, long-tail driving data. Autonomy is now a data race—and Uber has an edge: We collect rare, real-world driving data at a scale and capital efficiency no one else can match.

About the Role and Team
The Test and Verification team is part of Developer Platform, whose mission is to empower engineers at Uber to build reliable, scalable software efficiently and without friction. Developer Platform builds the languages, tools and infrastructure that thousands of Uber engineers, and increasingly AI agents, use every day to write, test and ship code. Within that, our team builds the systems that determine whether a change is safe to land. We focus on backend services at Uber's scale and work closely with the teams building agents and automation. Our goal is to make verification fast, trustworthy and meaningful, so Uber can ship more with less manual review.
Join us to help solve the biggest challenge in modern software development: verification. Code generation is cheap, so the bottleneck is knowing whether a change is correct and which tests actually tell us. In an agentic world, the question is no longer whether code was reviewed, but whether it was verified. We are looking for someone with vision to define what trustworthy verification looks like when agents write and check much of our code.
In this role you will build the systems that decide whether backend changes are safe to land. You will work hands-on to give humans and AI agents a clear signal on which tests are meaningful and trustworthy, and you will help set the team's technical direction. You will be a key contributor to the verification layer of Uber's software factory.
What You’ll Do
Build systems that measure the quality of backend tests beyond coverage, using techniques such as fault detection, mutation analysis and replay of real historical bugs.
Design and build the signals that tell engineers and agents which tests matter for a change, which are reliable, and what a failure means.
Build verification for AI-generated code, including independent test generation, behavioral validation and verification artifacts that CI can attest to.
Define how we evaluate agents, skills and validators that write or check code, using golden datasets, replay of real bugs and regression tracking across models and prompts.
Measure whether our verification signals can be trusted, such as how often judges and validators agree with real outcomes, so humans and agents know when to rely on them.
Reduce flakiness and make failures actionable, so engineers and agents know what failed, how to fix it and who to contact.
Define and track verification health, such as defect catch rate and flake rate, and catch regressions early.
Shape the vision for verification in an agentic world: spec-driven development, independent test generation, and verification evidence that CI can attest to, so human judgment moves from reviewing every PR to defining what correct means.
Contribute to the team's technical direction: write design docs, set standards, mentor engineers and partner with CI, build and product teams.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience).
8+ years of full-time software engineering experience.
Strong experience building and operating backend distributed systems.
Solid knowledge of algorithms, data structures and system design.
Demonstrated ability to set technical direction on ambiguous, high-impact problems.
Track record of delivering technical work across teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with test infrastructure, CI systems or developer productivity at scale.
Familiarity with test quality techniques such as mutation testing, fault injection, contract testing or flaky test management.
Experience designing evals or benchmarks for LLM or agent systems, with statistical rigor.
Experience applying LLMs or AI agents to developer tooling, code review or test generation.
Experience defining a technical vision and bringing teams and leadership along.
Experience with large monorepos and build systems such as Bazel.
Proficiency in Go or Java.

Senior Staff Security Engineer — Supply Chain, Offensive & AI Security
About this role and team
As a Senior Staff Security Engineer, you will define and build security platforms, developer tooling, and AI-powered automation that protect Uber’s software ecosystem at scale. Securing the software supply chain will be a core focus, alongside continuous offensive testing and security assessments of AI applications and autonomous agents.
This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. You will write production-quality code to protect source code, dependencies, build infrastructure, artifacts, and deployment pipelines. You will also build systems that automate penetration testing, vulnerability discovery and validation, adversarial AI testing, and remediation. Your work will advance both the use of AI to improve security and the security of AI itself, including first-party and third-party agents, LLM integrations, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and autonomous workflows.
Working across Security, Developer Infrastructure, and Engineering, you will establish technical strategy and lead complex initiatives from concept through deployment and long-term operation. You will embed controls into developer workflows, turn manual assessments into continuous capabilities, and eliminate systemic weaknesses through secure defaults and platform improvements.
Successful candidates combine expert software engineering with deep expertise in securing software delivery and offensive security. They build scalable systems that reduce real-world risk while improving developer productivity.
What you’ll do
Build software supply chain protections. Implement source code integrity, commit signing, code, artifact, and container signing, provenance verification, dependency integrity, and cryptographic verification. Establish standards and automated enforcement for secure builds, artifact repositories, container registries, and deployment pipelines that prevent untrusted code, unsigned artifacts, vulnerable dependencies, and noncompliant software from advancing.
Engineer dependency security and remediation systems. Build capabilities to inventory and assess open-source components, manage SBOMs, detect vulnerable or malicious packages and transitive dependency risks, and mitigate supply chain compromise. Automate dependency upgrades, secure patches, code fixes, and verification of remediation effectiveness.
Deliver scalable application security platforms. Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection, and AI-powered analysis into code generation, development, pull requests, and CI/CD. Analyze source code, build configurations, infrastructure definitions, containers, and artifacts at scale, and provide actionable feedback with minimal developer friction.
Turn threat models into engineering controls. Model threats across applications, APIs, identity systems, build infrastructure, cloud environments, and AI workflows. Identify trust boundaries, abuse cases, and attack paths, then implement secure defaults, reusable libraries, architectural improvements, and regression tests that eliminate recurring vulnerability classes.
Build continuous offensive security capabilities. Develop automated penetration testing, DAST, attack orchestration, and exploit validation systems for applications, APIs, mobile services, infrastructure, and externally accessible endpoints. Identify authorization weaknesses, business logic flaws, privilege escalation, and chained attacks, using isolated execution environments, attack sandboxes, and controls appropriate for production testing.
Build AI-powered security tools and test AI systems. Apply frontier models, security-specific models, and autonomous agents to discovery, attack planning, validation, secure coding, and remediation. Assess first-party and third-party agents, LLM integrations, MCP servers, and agent tools for prompt injection, tool poisoning, unauthorized execution, data exposure, and trust boundary violations.
Make findings accurate and actionable. Correlate and deduplicate findings, combine deterministic analysis with AI reasoning, dynamic testing, exploit verification, and human review, and prioritize validated risk. Continuously reassess applications and agents as code, configurations, models, tools, and integrations change.
Own production engineering and technical direction. Write maintainable, tested code; define architectures, APIs, interfaces, safety controls, and engineering standards; and operate reliable distributed services. Evaluate emerging technologies, prototype quickly, and lead initiatives across teams with clear milestones and measurable outcomes.
Raise engineering quality and adoption. Mentor senior engineers, lead design and code reviews, and partner with infrastructure and product teams to embed security into existing workflows. Communicate investment priorities and measure improvements in coverage, accuracy, remediation, developer adoption, productivity, and risk reduction.
Basic qualifications
Production software engineering: 10+ years of experience in software engineering, security engineering, or related technical fields, including significant experience designing, coding, testing, deploying, and operating complex production systems. Advanced proficiency in Go, Java, Python, C++, or a comparable language.
Systems architecture: Experience building large-scale distributed systems, developer platforms, security services, or infrastructure, supported by strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, APIs, concurrency, system design, and software architecture.
Secure software delivery: Deep understanding of source control, build systems, dependency management, CI/CD, containers, and cloud-native deployment, with experience implementing automated controls in developer workflows. Expert-level depth in application security, software supply chain security, or DevSecOps.
Application security and threat modeling: Strong understanding of secure design, authentication, authorization, trust boundaries, and application and API vulnerabilities, including OWASP Top 10, injection, business logic flaws, and multi-step attacks. Ability to translate threat models and security findings into concrete engineering changes.
Offensive security engineering: Expert-level depth in penetration testing, vulnerability research, exploit development, application testing, or adversarial testing, with experience building or integrating scanners, exploitation frameworks, DAST, or automated validation capabilities.
Infrastructure security: Strong fundamentals in network, cloud, and infrastructure security, and familiarity with microservices, Kubernetes, distributed applications, and modern cloud-native architectures.
Technical ownership: Demonstrated ability to resolve ambiguous problems and independently lead initiatives across teams from problem definition through implementation and long-term operation, using scalable engineering solutions to address systemic weaknesses.
Influence and collaboration: Ability to establish technical direction without direct authority, communicate architectural decisions, and work effectively across security and engineering organizations.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred qualifications
Supply chain integrity and standards: Expertise in SBOMs, software provenance, dependency integrity, code, artifact, and container signing, and cryptographic verification; experience implementing SLSA, Sigstore, in-toto, OpenSSF, or equivalent frameworks and technologies.
Build and delivery infrastructure: Deep experience with CI/CD architecture, artifact repositories, container registries, deployment orchestration, and automated policy enforcement. Hands-on experience with tools such as JFrog Artifactory, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Buildkite, CircleCI, and Argo CD, including integrations with source control, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure.
Security platform development: A record of shipping and operating backend services, analysis engines, and developer infrastructure across large codebases, monorepos, microrepositories, and distributed environments. Expertise in SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, secure code analysis, and automated remediation through code fixes, dependency updates, patch generation, and verification.
Threat modeling and secure architecture: Experience leading threat modeling for software delivery systems, applications, APIs, and AI agents, and implementing the resulting mitigations. Deep knowledge of service-to-service authentication, identity, messaging, data stores, containers, Kubernetes, and multi-cloud architectures.
Offensive automation: Experience building penetration testing frameworks, exploitation engines, attack orchestration, scalable DAST, and systems that generate, execute, and validate exploits in authorized environments. Expertise in web, API, mobile, cloud, and distributed systems testing, attack-path analysis, privilege escalation, and lateral movement; familiarity with Burp Suite, Nuclei, OWASP ZAP, Metasploit, Invicti, or comparable tools.
AI-powered security engineering: Experience building with LLMs, frontier or cybersecurity-focused models, autonomous agents, or multi-agent architectures for source analysis, reconnaissance, attack planning, vulnerability discovery, exploitability assessment, secure code generation, and remediation. Experience combining deterministic analysis, multi-model reasoning, runtime verification, and human review.
AI security testing: Experience assessing agents, LLM applications, MCP servers, tools, and third-party integrations for direct and indirect prompt injection, tool poisoning, insecure invocation, privilege escalation, data exfiltration, and cross-agent trust violations. Experience building red teaming frameworks with live endpoint testing, multi-turn adversarial interactions, dynamic validation, and isolated execution infrastructure.
Developer experience and measurable outcomes: Experience integrating continuous testing and enforcement into development and production workflows while minimizing friction. Ability to measure discovery and exploit validation rates, precision, recall, false positives, remediation, enforcement and attack coverage, automation, adoption, and risk reduction.
Sustained technical leadership: Experience turning research and prototypes into maintainable production services, setting multi-year technical direction, mentoring senior engineers, and raising standards through architecture guidance and code review.
