About the Role
Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We're building out a high-velocity team of multi-disciplinary experts to turn real-world operations into high-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team is focused on the hardest problem in AV today: unlocking real-world, long-tail driving data. Autonomy is now a data race—and Uber has an edge: We collect rare, real-world driving data at a scale and capital efficiency no one else can match.
Our AV Labs Hardware team is pioneering the next-generation E/E architecture for our cutting-edge L4 data collectioncapable vehicle fleet.You will drive critical projects ranging from initial 3rd-party hardware driver and firmware development to the embedded development, bring-up, and deployment of our in-house designed production hardware. As a Senior Embedded Engineer, your technical expertise will directly accelerate our path to production, playing a key role in shaping the reliability of our autonomous data collection fleet.
What the Candidate Will Do
Develop Core Firmware & Drivers: Design, write, and maintain robust firmware and low-level device drivers for 3rd-party automotive-grade components and critical AV sensors (LiDAR, radar, cameras) to enable immediate, high-fidelity data collection and shadow mode operations.
Drive In-House Hardware Bring-Up: Execute the transition to production by taking ownership of board bring-up, hardware validation, and low-level software deployment for our custom, in-house designed autonomous computing platforms.
Collaborate on HW/SW Co-Design: Partner closely with electrical and hardware engineering teams to implement hardware-software interfaces, participate in schematic reviews, and ensure component selection aligns with firmware requirements.
Debug & Optimize Complex Systems: Utilize hardware debugging tools (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers) and software profiling to troubleshoot intricate system-level issues, optimize sensor data pipelines, and ensure strict timing and network synchronization across the vehicle.
Contribute to Team Excellence: Act as a technical resource and mentor within the hardware team, actively contributing to best practices for embedded software architecture, code quality, and scalable deployment.
Basic Qualifications
Embedded Software Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, accompanied by 5+ years of professional experience developing embedded software using modern C/C++ in RTOS (e.g., FreeRTOS, Embedded Linux) or bare-metal environments.
Low-Level Driver & Automotive Hardware Expertise: Strong experience writing firmware and device drivers for complex, automotive-grade components, SoCs, and autonomous vehicle sensors (e.g., LiDAR, radar, cameras). This must include hands-on experience with sensor integration, board bring-up, hardware debugging tools (e.g., oscilloscopes, logic analyzers), and familiarity with standard automotive interfaces and vehicle networks (e.g., CAN/CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet, FPD-Link/GMSL, PCIe, SPI, I2C).
Production Lifecycle Execution: Demonstrated experience contributing to embedded hardware systems from initial prototyping and 3rd-party integration through to production deployment—ideally within the autonomous vehicle, robotics, or mission-critical automotive domains.
Preferred Qualifications
Hardware-Software Co-Design: Experience collaborating closely with electrical and hardware engineers on custom board designs, including participation in schematic reviews and component selection for computing platforms.
Functional Safety & Automotive Standards: Understanding of automotive functional safety standards and their application in embedded software development, including experience with ISO 26262 (ASIL B through ASIL D) compliance and adherence to coding guidelines like MISRA C/C++.
Advanced Timing & Synchronization: Experience with distributed system timing and hardware synchronization methodologies critical for sensor fusion. Familiarity with Precision Time Protocol (PTP/gPTP, IEEE 802.1AS) and hardware PPS routing across complex vehicle networks is highly valued.
High-Performance AV Compute Platforms: Experience developing firmware and drivers for modern, high-performance autonomous driving SoCs and compute platforms (e.g., NVIDIA DRIVE, Qualcomm Snapdragon Ride) and optimizing data pipelines utilizing hardware accelerators (GPUs, DSPs, NPUs).

We focus on establishing industry-leading architectural standards, building shared backend platform components, and guaranteeing business continuity under extreme traffic demands. Uber AI Solutions (UAIS) is a startup inside Uber, building the data and evaluation infrastructure behind the next generation of AI. The models making headlines are only as good as the data and feedback they learn from, and that is the work we do.
We are an agile team moving at startup speed with the full weight of Uber behind us: global reach, world class infrastructure, and one of the largest human networks in the world. We pair that network with machine learning to produce the high quality, model ready data that the most advanced AI teams on earth depend on. Our work spans every modality, from text, images, and video to audio and physical AI and AVs, and reaches across dozens of countries.
This is a place for builders who want real ownership. Here you own a problem, not a ticket: you take a vertical from start to finish, the machine learning, the backend systems, and the product, and drive it from a blank page to something the best customers in AI rely on every day. You work shoulder to shoulder with product managers and other exceptional engineers, go as deep as the problem demands, and make the calls that decide whether your area wins. It is the closest thing to running your own company, with a rocket strapped to it.
If you want your work to show up in the AI systems shaping the world, and you want to build it like a founder, this is the team.
What You'll Do
Build the ML and backend systems that turn your vision into a product customers pay for and rely on, going as deep as the problem requires.
Own your vertical end to end: find the opportunities, set the direction, and drive the business metrics that matter, such as revenue, adoption, and customer value.
Move fast in ambiguity: prioritize ruthlessly, make the calls, and turn ideas into shipped, revenue generating products with a product manager and a small senior team.
Be a trusted technical partner in the customer relationship where relevant, using what you learn to grow the account.
Raise the bar on execution and quality so your business can scale.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's or equivalent work experience in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
5+ years of professional experience designing, building, and operating production ML systems, including strong backend engineering across the full path from data to serving.
Track record of driving business impact, not just shipping features: you have owned a product or product line and helped move metrics such as revenue, adoption, or customer value.
Fluency in Python for machine learning and a production systems language such as Go, Java, or C++, and the ability to build reliable services and run them in production.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and moving fast: you find the highest value problems yourself, make the call, and drive them without waiting to be told.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to align customers, product, and engineering around what will grow the business.
Preferred Qualifications
Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
You have grown a product or business line in a startup or startup like environment, owning outcomes end to end and treating revenue and customer growth as your job.
Experience applying machine learning to a real world data or evaluation domain, such as physical world data collection, RL environments and agentic evaluation, multilingual or audio data, or data quality and verification, where success was measured by business impact rather than model metrics alone.
Direct experience with GenAI and LLM systems in production, including evaluation harnesses, model tuning, forced alignment or ASR, or pipelines that keep a model in the loop.
Depth in one or more UAIS domains: real world and physical world data such as POI and embodied capture, agentic RL environments, multilingual and multimodal ML, video and LiDAR annotation, or physical AI and robotics data.

Working in Science at Uber means solving complex problems in a high-stakes, fast-moving environment. You’ll turn massive amounts of unstructured data into focused plans of execution, navigating ambiguity to build technologies that directly influence every decision made in our marketplace. In this role, you’ll be the bridge between technical depth and business impact, solving messy, high-priority problems that don’t always have a textbook solution. You’ll thrive here if you possess an owner’s mindset, stay calm under pressure, and have the grit to drive projects through their entire lifecycle from idea inception to production.

We’re looking for someone who thinks critically and moves quickly, adapting the best tools for the moment to solve real-world transportation problems.

About the Role
We are looking for a hardware focused Senior Reliability Engineer to focus on sensor and hardware system reliability, owning the observability, alerting, and automation that ensures Uber’s in-vehicle sensor data collection systems operate reliably at scale.
This role is centered on maximizing sensor uptime, data yield, and supply hours across a large, geographically distributed fleet. You will design systems that determine when to react to issues impacting data recording capability, whether caused by failing sensors, degraded onboard computers, software regressions, or systemic environmental factors.
As the technical owner for sensor reliability and observability, you will build the infrastructure that converts low-level signals into actionable intelligence and automated responses. This is a senior role requiring strong software engineering fundamentals, deep systems thinking, and the ability to drive cross-team technical direction without direct authority.
What You Will Do
Architect Observability Systems: Design and scale an observability platform capable of ingesting and analyzing real-time health telemetry from thousands of distributed vehicle nodes.
Build for Edge Constraints: Develop systems that remain performant despite hardware diversity, intermittent connectivity, and rapid fleet scaling.
Define Criticality Models: Establish alerting strategies that distinguish transient anomalies from systemic issues impacting sensor uptime and data yield.
Detect Complex Failure Modes: Design detection logic for "silent" failures, such as sensor degradation, compute saturation, or recording pipeline stalls.
Scale Through Automation: Design automated detection, triage, and mitigation mechanisms to eliminate manual intervention as the fleet grows.
Partner on Mitigation: Collaborate with Operations and Engineering to build safe, automated responses to recurring hardware and software failure scenarios.
Drive Operational Efficiency: Build technical interfaces to help Operations surface issues and Engineering diagnose and deploy mitigations rapidly (TTD/TTM).
Lead Technical Strategy: Drive reliability-focused design reviews and translate operational pain points into concrete technical requirements and roadmaps.
Uncover Proactive Insights: Apply advanced data analytics to identify latent patterns in fleet telemetry, enabling the proactive detection of systemic regressions and hardware degradation before they impact operations.
Basic Qualifications
5+ years of relevant industry experience in software engineering, site reliability, or systems engineering
Distributed Systems: Experience with modern observability platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) in edge, IoT, or hardware-integrated environments.
Language Proficiency: coding skills in one or more of Go, Python, or C++ , with experience building and operating production systems.
Systems Expertise: Proficiency in Linux internals and shell scripting for triaging and debugging edge devices or hardware-adjacent systems.
Engineering Fundamentals: Ability to debug across services, containers (Docker), and networking stacks.
Reliability Experience: Proven track record owning reliability, infrastructure, or platform systems for large-scale production workloads.
Observability Tooling: Experience designing and operating observability systems (metrics, logging, alerting, and dashboards).
Metrics-Driven: Experience defining and implementing SLIs and SLOs for system availability or data yield.
Networking Knowledge: Deep understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, gRPC, or MQTT) and data handling in bandwidth-constrained environments.
Leadership: Experience driving complex technical projects and architectural reviews across multiple teams from design through production.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with modern observability platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) in edge, IoT, or hardware-integrated environments.
Knowledge of sensor data protocols (e.g., Camera, LiDAR, Radar) or hardware-to-cloud data ingestion pipelines.
Experience with "Grey Failure" detection and management in complex, distributed systems.
Proven track record in 'Fleet Health' for large-scale hardware deployments (e.g., cloud infrastructure, global server fleets, or industrial IoT) where automation was used to replace manual intervention.

About the Team
The Deliverability team sits at the core of Uber’s delivery marketplace as part of Merchant Optimization. Serving as the critical gating layer for every Uber Eats transaction, our systems answer the fundamental real-time question: "Can this merchant deliver to this eater right now?"
We optimize merchant delivery zones to maximize platform selection while balancing marketplace reliability, timeliness, and profitability. The decision made by the deliverability services directly shape selection breadth and business metrics across key downstream platforms, including Search, Feed, and Ads.
Role & Responsibilities
As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Deliverability team, you will drive the technical vision, end-to-end design, and productionization of core ML systems powering global delivery marketplace decisions. Specifically, you will:
Product & Domain ML Architecture: Architect and translate complex marketplace challenges into high-throughput, large scale ML solutions for delivery zone optimization.
Design & Train Core Models: Develop, evaluate, and continuously refine state-of-the-art machine learning models that dynamically optimize merchant delivery coverage, balancing conversion, order volume, and fulfillment efficiency.
Production Pipelines & ML Infrastructure: Engineer, deploy, and operate scalable ML inference pipelines, feature stores, model serving infrastructure, and automated retraining workflows handling high-throughput global delivery evaluations.
Marketplace Optimization & Experimentation: Lead data-driven investigations to diagnose marketplace inefficiencies, execute online A/B testing and leverage telemetry to drive core business metrics.
Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Partner closely with Product Management, Data Science, Operations, and Core Infrastructure teams to align technical roadmaps and define cross-platform ML standards.
Basic Qualifications
5+ years of hands-on professional experience designing, training, and operating production ML models at scale.
Proactive and strong analytical mindset with a passion for uncovering insights from complex data distributions to drive technical decision-making and project buy-in.
Advanced proficiency in Python and mainstream machine learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn).
Solid theoretical foundation in classic and modern ML algorithms, including and not limited to gradient-boosted trees (XGBoost, LightGBM), deep neural networks, and statistical modeling.
Proven record of taking complex ML systems end-to-end from initial problem formulation and offline validation to large-scale production deployment.
Practical experience developing automated feature engineering pipelines, using feature store technologies, model monitoring platforms, and executing controlled online A/B testing in production.
Preferred Qualifications
PhD candidate 3+ years of industry experience
Experience with geospatial libraries (e.g., H3, S2 Cell).
Experience with Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), and/or deep learning recommendation systems.
Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional technical initiatives, mentor junior engineers, and deliver complex multi-phase engineering projects.
Familiarity with distributed data processing systems (e.g., Spark, Ray, Flink) and foundational concepts in two-sided marketplace optimization.

Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We’re building out a high-velocity team of multi-disciplinary experts to turn real-world operations into high-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team is focused on the hardest problem in AV today: unlocking real-world, long-tail driving data. Uber AI Solutions (UAIS) is a startup inside Uber, building the data and evaluation infrastructure behind the next generation of AI. The models making headlines are only as good as the data and feedback they learn from, and that is the work we do.

Deep expertise in both machine learning systems and backend distributed systems, with the ability to build production systems that scale as the business grows.

Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with the ability to align customers, product, and business leadership around a growth agenda.

Design, develop, and productionize end-to-end ML solutions for large-scale distributed systems serving billions of trips

2+ years of experience in developing and deploying machine learning models and optimization algorithms in large-scale production environments
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Scala, Java, or Go
Experience with large-scale data systems (e.g. Spark, Ray), real-time processing (e.g. Flink), and microservices architectures
Experience in the development, training, productionization and monitoring of ML solutions at scale, ranging from offline pipelines to online serving and MLOps
Familiarity with modern ML algorithms (e.g. DNNs, multi-task models, transformers) and mathematical optimization (e.g. LP, convex optimization), combined with proven ability and ambition to continuously deepen expertise in these areas
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in translating ambiguous business problems into technical solutions in a structured and principled way
Strong communication skills, including through documentation and design discussions
Experience in developing and deploying pricing algorithms for multi-sided real-time marketplaces with strategic agent behavior
Experience in reinforcement learning and causal machine learning

The CyberSecurity Incident Response team (CIRT) is at the forefront of protecting Uber, our customers, and our partners from evolving security threats. We are a hands-on, fast-paced team that responds to security incidents, conducts forensic investigations, and builds automated solutions to scale our defence.
As a Security Analyst on the CIRT team, you will be a key player in our incident response efforts. This is a technical and investigative role where you'll be responsible for:
Responding to security incidents and mitigating threats across the company.
Conducting in-depth investigations and digital forensics to uncover the root cause of attacks.
Developing and implementing automation solutions using tools like SIEM and SOAR to improve our response capabilities.
Collaborating with other security and engineering teams to address vulnerabilities and strengthen our security posture.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively under pressure.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

About the Team
Uber's Finance Data Platform team builds and operates the foundational data products that power Uber's financial and profitability insights. We produce trusted, reconciled, and scalable financial and performance metrics used across all of Uber's Lines of Business (LOBs) and Products.
Our datasets and metrics sit at the core of how Uber understands business performance today and plans for tomorrow: they support reporting, forecasting, profitability analyses, investment cases, and future capital allocation decisions. We partner closely with Finance, Accounting, FP&A, Product, Data, and Operations teams to ensure stakeholders have a single source of truth for financial and profitability performance.
About the Role
As an App Developer / Data Analyst II on the Finance Data Platform team, you will use data to shape how Uber measures and understands business performance and profitability. You will own key financial and profitability metrics, build scalable reporting and analytical views, and deliver insights that directly influence strategic decisions and capital allocation across Uber.
You will act as a thought partner to Finance, Operations and Product leaders, translating complex financial and operational data into clear stories and recommendations, and helping ensure that decisions are anchored on high-quality, consistent metrics. You will also help design GenAI-powered self-serve tools that allow internal customers to get fast, intuitive answers from Finance Data Platform data and metrics.
What You'll Do
Partner with Finance, FP&A, Accounting, Product, Operations, and Data Science teams to deeply understand how Uber measures revenue, costs, margins, and profitability across LOBs, products, and geographies.
Own and refine core financial and profitability metric definitions (e.g., revenue, variable cost, contribution margin, unit economics) and ensure they are consistently implemented and well documented across dashboards and data products.
Design, build, and maintain curated data models, views, and dashboards that provide a single source of truth for business performance analyses and financial reporting.
Design and iterate on GenAI-powered self-serve analytics tools (e.g., natural-language query interfaces, chat-based explainers) that help internal customers quickly get answers and explanations from Finance Data Platform metrics.
Analyze large-scale financial and operational datasets to identify trends, drivers, and anomalies in revenue, cost, profitability, and efficiency.
Support strategic planning and capital allocation processes by providing data-driven insights on business performance, ROI, and investment trade-offs.
Partner with Finance and Product teams to define and track KPIs for new products, features, and business initiatives, ensuring that performance is measured consistently over time.
Improve metric quality and reliability by collaborating with data engineers and finance stakeholders on data pipelines, controls, and reconciliation between financial systems and analytical datasets.
Communicate complex analyses, assumptions, and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative and business field.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including experience working with large-scale analytical data warehouses and complex joins/transformations.
Proficiency in at least one scripting or analysis language such as Python or R for deeper analysis, automation, and data quality checks.
Experience building and maintaining dashboards and reports in a modern BI tool (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI) for Finance or business stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems, define and operationalize metrics, and design analyses end-to-end.
Strong communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to explain complex financial and technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and drive alignment on recommendations.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in fintech, financial services, or working closely with Finance, FP&A, or Accounting teams in a data or analytics capacity.
Clear understanding of financial concepts such as revenue recognition, cost allocation, unit economics, contribution margin, forecasting, and capital allocation.
Experience working with financial data models and reconciliations between source systems (e.g., billing, payments, ledgers, ERP) and analytical layers.
Experience supporting planning, forecasting, or performance management processes with data and metrics.

About the role:
Product Design at Uber is about more than just making things look good—it's about architecting how people and things move in the physical world. As a Lead Product Designer, you will turn massive complexity into clarity at speed, navigate competing priorities, and lead through influence, not control. This is a high-impact environment where you will solve what is hard to shape the future of movement.
This role is on our Earner design team, building the platform Earners rely on to plan and move through their day. You'll shape how millions of Drivers and Couriers experience Uber across surfaces and form factors, from tablet and foldable phone design to the earner assistant, where AI and voice help people navigate their day hands-free. You'll also contribute to the universal systems every earner interaction depends on, like how the app handles loading and latency. You'll work closely with engineers, data scientists, product managers, and some of the best designers and researchers in the field, in a fast-paced, collaborative setting.
This is a 0-to-1 role. You'll make big decisions without perfect information and own the outcomes, whether that means defining how an Earner interacts with a foldable device or how they speak to their assistant to plan out their day. You'll navigate high-stakes ambiguity, balance near-term execution with long-term vision, and advocate for the user in a fast-moving, technical space. If you think critically and thrive on solving problems with real-world impact at a global scale, this is where you'll grow.
What You Will Do:
Lead human-centered experience design for high-impact domains, defining new interaction patterns and service models where none exist today, including for voice-first experiences.
Own design problems end-to-end, from early-stage research and conceptual wireframes to high-fidelity prototypes and final production-ready assets.
Design conversational and voice interactions for the earner assistant, helping Earners plan and move through their day hands-free.
Partner as a key thought leader with Product, Engineering, and Operations to define requirements and shape the strategic roadmap, not just translate them into mocks.
Design across digital and physical touchpoints, translating complex logistical and technical systems into clear, intuitive flows for mobile, tablet, foldable, and voice interfaces.
Maintain and evolve Uber's design language by contributing to shared systems and foundational patterns, including universal systems like loading and latency, that ensure consistency across global platforms.
Prototype rapidly to test hypotheses and validate ideas early, using data and user research to iterate and raise the bar for quality and trustworthiness.
Time Spent in the Day:
40% Crafting UI/UX designs, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes in Figma or with AI.
25% Collaborating cross-functionally to define requirements and align on product strategy.
15% Partnering with UXR and Data Science to validate designs and analyze user feedback.
10% Mentoring other designers and contributing to shared design systems and patterns.
10% Presenting work to stakeholders and advocating for design-led solutions
Basic Qualifications:
8+ years of professional product design experience, with a track record of shipping successful digital products for mobile and web.
A portfolio showcasing high-quality design work, strong systems thinking, and a deep understanding of user-centered design principles.
Proficiency with Figma and a range of prototyping tools to bring complex ideas to life.
Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity and lead design direction in fast-paced, evolving environments.
Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale to technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience designing for multiple form factors and input methods, such as mobile, tablet, foldable devices, or voice.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience designing AI-powered or LLM-driven product experiences, including how to handle uncertainty, errors, and trust in AI-generated content.
Experience designing conversational or voice user interfaces (VUI), including how to structure a natural back-and-forth voice interaction.
Experience in frontier or complex domains such as Autonomous Systems, AdTech, Fintech, or Enterprise/Operational tools.
Experience designing across physical and digital touchpoints, including geospatial or location-aware systems.
Proven ability to collaborate with user researchers and data scientists to drive experimentation and A/B testing.
Advanced degree in HCI, Interaction Design, Industrial Design, or a related field.
Experience building and implementing components within a global, scalable design system.

About the Role
Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We're building out a high-velocity team of multi-disciplinary experts to turn real-world operations into high-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team is focused on the hardest bottleneck in AV today: unlocking real-world, long-tail driving data. Autonomy is now a data race—and Uber has an edge: We collect rare, real-world driving data at a scale and capital efficiency no one else can match.
As a Fleet Engineering Lead, you will help scale and optimize fleet operations for our Autonomous Vehicle (AV) data collection projects. You will operate as the on-site technical lead, sitting at the intersection of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, and daily fleet operations. You will diagnose complex system faults, translate engineering designs into clear shop-floor playbooks, and lead the technical rollout of vehicle data collection support across new cities. This is a unique opportunity to be part of a high-impact initiative that will continue to evolve as we scale.
What You’ll Do
Scale-Out & Site Bootstrapping: Launch data collection in new cities, overseeing the technical setup from vehicle hardware to data offload. Adapt playbooks for local nuances, train local contractor staff, and build the operational cadence before handing off steady-state control.
Advanced Diagnostics: Serve as the final on-site escalation point for complex, undocumented hardware and software faults, performing deep root-cause analysis when issues extend beyond standard troubleshooting guides.
Upfit Validation & Serviceability: Validate hardware/software integration on newly upfitted vehicles (e.g., from Roush) upon arrival. Evaluate practical depot-level serviceability and translate complex engineering documentation into actionable maintenance workflows.
SOP Architecture & Fleet Standardization: Design, test, and formally document the core triage, calibration, and maintenance playbooks. Conduct cross-site technical audits to ensure uniform execution and resolve local bottlenecks.
Process Automation & Tooling: Identify operational bottlenecks on the depot floor and test or develop local scripts and tooling to automate repetitive tasks (e.g., firmware deployment) and accelerate data collection fleet throughput.
Basic Qualifications
5+ years of experience in an advanced technical role working with complex electromechanical systems, autonomous vehicles, aerospace testing, or enterprise hardware integration.
Strong problem-solving ability with demonstrated capability to figure things out in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.
Proficiency in Linux troubleshooting and scripting (Python or Bash preferred) to interact with vehicle compute, pull raw logs, and automate local depot tooling.
Process Architecture Experience: Proven track record of documenting complex technical workflows, writing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and training technical teams to execute them safely.
Hands-on Hardware Experience: Deep familiarity with networking concepts, sensor integration (LiDAR, Radar, Cameras, IMU), or automotive data links (CAN, Automotive Ethernet, GMSL).
Willingness to travel up to 50% to bootstrap new data collection cities and conduct cross-site technical audits.
Preferred Qualifications
AV Domain Expertise: Direct experience working with L4 autonomous vehicle hardware platforms, sensor calibration rigs, and data collection workflows.
Launch & Scale Experience: Previous experience serving as a bootstrap lead, NPI technician, or "landing team" member for new operational sites or data centers.
Cross-Functional Influence: Proven track record of influencing cross-functional engineering teams (Hardware, Software, Logistics) to drive improvements in product serviceability and operational workflows.
Vendor / Upfit Experience: Experience receiving and validating complex systems from third-party upfitters or contract manufacturers.

About the Role
Uber's Tech Risk and Assurance team, part of Engineering Security, helps Uber understand its cybersecurity risk, decide what to do about it, and prove that controls work. Our goal is to make every experience with Uber simple, secure, and safe for riders, eaters, drivers, and partners.
As a Senior Security Technologist, GRC, you will run key parts of Uber's cyber risk management program: risk intake and assessment, risk treatment and acceptance decisions, and the reporting leaders use to see where risk sits and what has been decided. You will partner with engineering, security, audit, privacy, and compliance teams to turn control gaps, threat context, and regulatory requirements into treatment plans that engineering teams can execute, and follow those plans through to closure.
This role combines risk judgment with hands-on technical skill. You will be comfortable reading architecture and design documents, querying data, and building automation on GRC platforms and workflow tools so that risk processes scale without adding manual work. You will work within program goals set with senior leadership and own the design and delivery of the components assigned to you.
What You'll Do
Own cyber risk intake, triage, and prioritization for your program area, so that each risk has a clear owner, a well-formed risk statement, and a timely treatment decision.
Lead risk assessments, including annual and targeted assessments of systems, applications, and new business areas, and present results with clear recommendations.
Run the risk exception and acceptance workflow. Confirm that requests have the right context, route them to the right approver, track conditions and expiry dates, and escalate decisions that exceed delegated authority or risk tolerance.
Partner with engineering teams to define risk treatment plans, identify sustainable fixes, and drive mitigation to the last mile rather than stopping at documentation.
Contribute to control design reviews and risk decisions that require judgment, stakeholder alignment, and trade-off management.
Own the roadmap and delivery of one or more components of Uber's risk and compliance tooling. Gather requirements from partner teams, write technical specifications, and work with engineers to ship releases in an Agile delivery model.
Configure and improve workflows on GRC platforms such as ServiceNow eGRC and Jira, including forms, business rules, client scripts, UI actions, and automation rules.
Build automation that removes manual steps from risk workflows using Python, SQL, platform APIs, workflow tools, and approved AI tools. Examples include routing approvals, expiring acceptances, and drafting first-pass risk summaries for human review.
Load, transform, and reconcile data between GRC platforms and other systems, and perform system and integration testing with sample and live data.
Build and maintain risk reporting for leaders and partner teams, including KRIs, exposure trends, acceptance aging, decision status, and escalation triggers. Design dashboards and reports that support program requirements.
Prepare material for risk governance forums, including decision papers that set out the risk, the options, and a recommendation.
Improve risk workflows through better tooling, clearer operating models, and reusable knowledge assets such as runbooks and templates.
Mentor and onboard analysts and junior team members on risk analysis, risk statement quality, treatment planning, and stakeholder communication.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of experience in security, cyber risk, GRC, assurance, security operations, or related technical risk roles.
Experience running parts of a security risk program end to end, including risk assessments, treatment decisions, and cross-functional follow-through.
Strong understanding of security controls and risk treatment, with the technical fluency to work with engineers on implementation details in areas such as identity and access, cloud infrastructure, logging, vulnerability management, and secure configuration.
Hands-on automation experience, including scripting in Python or a similar language, querying data with SQL, and using APIs or workflow tools to automate a process.
Knowledge of control frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and CIS.
Experience working across multiple stakeholders, handling ambiguity, and driving accountability with limited supervision.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting risk, status, and decision points to director-level and technical audiences.
Preferred Qualifications
Security or audit certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor.
Hands-on experience with the ServiceNow eGRC platform, including configuration, workflow development, and integration.
Experience with other GRC or ERM tools such as AuditBoard, Archer, OpenPages,Vanta or SAP GRC.
Experience applying AI or LLM tools to risk work, such as summarizing evidence, classifying findings, or drafting assessments, with appropriate human review.
Experience with risk quantification methodologies and risk lifecycle tooling.
Experience building dashboards in tools such as Tableau, Looker, or ServiceNow Performance Analytics.
Big 4 accounting firm and/or internet or technology industry experience.
Process management experience, including process redesign and optimization.
Track record of driving security risk treatment to closure across multiple engineering teams.
Ability to thrive in environments of uncertainty.

About the Role
Uber is investing in the platforms, tools, and infrastructure needed to help autonomy partners deploy commercially and serve riders at scale. As the largest on-demand mobility and delivery platform in the world, Uber brings deep expertise in marketplace management, fleet utilization, and local operations—making it uniquely positioned to help partners commercialize autonomous technology globally. We’re building the foundation—from vehicle integration to fleet operations to rider experience—to make autonomy work in the real world.
As Uber expands autonomous deployments globally, vehicle platform design matters more than ever. As the Lead Product Manager for Autonomous Vehicle Platforms, you will be a critical early leader defining how autonomous vehicles are built to operate on Uber at scale. You will define the technical requirements—from OEM specifications to onboard hardware and software requirements—for vehicles to launch and operate as a high-duty cycle, high-reliability robotaxis on Uber. Your requirements will directly shape production vehicles across multiple vehicle generations and global deployments. You will define the interface between Uber’s platform and autonomous vehicle systems—setting the standard for how autonomous vehicles integrate, operate, and scale globally.
You will work closely with a high caliber cross functional team including vehicle strategy, engineering, design, operations, and external partners to translate strategy into concrete vehicle requirements, release criteria, and integration decisions. You will also serve as the primary technical product owner in partner and OEM discussions, responsible for system requirements decisions with long-term implications.
This role is ideal for a product leader with strong vehicle systems expertise, experience bringing complex hardware to market, and the judgment to make durable platform decisions in ambiguous, high-stakes environments.
What the Candidate Will Do
Own the platform strategy and requirements for Autonomous Vehicle Platforms, defining what partner vehicles must support to operate reliably and efficiently on Uber.
Define and maintain minimum vehicle specifications across OEM partnerships and vehicle programs, ensuring each can support Uber’s current and future commercialization use cases.
Own the evolving set of vehicle platform requirements across onboard hardware, embedded software, interfaces, and core system architecture, updating them based on partner needs and evolving autonomous technology.
Partner closely with business development and vehicle strategy teams at Uber to align on cost and capability trade offs and roles and responsibilities for our partnerships.
Serve as the primary technical product representative in partner and OEM engagements, driving alignment, resolving requirement gaps, and pulling in the right internal experts as needed.
Drive key trade-off decisions across cost, manufacturability, reliability, serviceability, scalability, and performance to ensure durable platform choices.
Build the mechanisms needed to support execution at scale, including requirements documents, interface definitions, decision frameworks, and readiness criteria.
Communicate roadmap direction, technical risks, requirement changes, and key decisions clearly to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Basic Qualifications
Demonstrated experience building and launching complex hardware or vehicle products from prototype through production, including managing firmware dependencies, validation, and release milestones.
Experience working directly with OEMs and/or Tier 1 suppliers to define requirements, manage interfaces, and align on development and release schedules.
Strong technical fluency in vehicle systems and architecture, with the ability to make sound product and integration trade-offs across mechanical, electrical, embedded, and software domains.
Proven ability to independently own ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives and drive them from definition through execution.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience representing technical requirements with senior internal teams and external partners.
Up to 40% domestic and international travel to work closely with OEMs and autonomy partners.
Preferred Qualifications
Background in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, vehicle architecture, or a related technical field, or equivalent product experience.
Experience in autonomous vehicles, advanced automotive systems, robotics, consumer electronics, aerospace, or other complex hardware domains.
Prior experience in roles such as Engineering Program Manager, Technical Program Manager, Vehicle Line Manager, systems-focused Product Manager, Systems Engineering or equivalent.
Experience defining system-level requirements that span hardware and software and carry across multiple vehicle programs or generations.
Comfort operating in highly technical environments where platform decisions have long-term implications for commercialization strategy.

Uber’s vision of “igniting opportunity by setting the world in motion” depends on our customers seamlessly paying for goods and services and our ability to reliably pay our partners. Additionally, we must ensure that each commerce interaction is accurately recorded and transparent to all parties involved.

About the Role
The security organization at Uber is dedicated to enabling safe and secure innovation while protecting the communities we serve both online and in the physical world. Our teams are responsible for protecting both people and their data across intersections of the digital and physical world. The primary objective for the Uber Engineering Security team is to enable the technical ambitions of the company while maintaining the highest standards of security and privacy for our customers and partners. As cybersecurity threats evolve, so do we.
We are seeking a Senior Security Engineer to join our Network Security team, with a primary focus on Bot Defense and DDoS Mitigation. In this role, you will help design, build, and optimize scalable network security systems, algorithms, and automated defense mechanisms to protect our global services against automated threats, volumetric attacks, and malicious bot activity. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to enforce policies, improve real-time threat detection, and maintain system resilience at scale.

Design, implement, and scale distributed backend systems and real-time algorithms to detect, prevent, and mitigate automated bot attacks and volumetric DDoS threats targeting edge and network infrastructure.
Leverage real-time streaming frameworks and machine learning capabilities to process network telemetry, identify traffic anomalies, and mitigate threats.
Automate and enforce network access controls, segmentation policies, and edge security configurations using Terraform.
Improve security visibility, logging, and metrics within container-based and cloud-native environments.
Monitor network traffic and security dashboards to respond to ongoing security incidents, partner with internal engineering teams on threat resolution, and embed security best practices across services.
Drive technical quality through rigorous code and design reviews, establish operational runbooks, and mentor junior engineers within the team.

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
5+ years of professional full-time experience in software engineering, cybersecurity, or network security engineering.
Proficiency in at least one production programming language: Go, Java.
Deep understanding of network protocols and concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, firewalls, proxies, VPNs, and network segmentation.
Experience with cloud technologies (e.g., AWS, GCP, OCI) and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
Preferred Qualifications
Direct experience in network security, cybersecurity, bot detection, or DDoS mitigation at scale.
Hands-on experience incorporating AI/ML models into production systems and working with real-time streaming frameworks (e.g., Apache Flink, Kafka).
Experience with Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) platforms (e.g., Zscaler).

ABOUT THE ROLE
Uber’s Marketing team invests hundreds of millions globally to grow our Mobility and Delivery platforms. We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager of Applied Science to lead strategic measurement and quantify the true impact of our marketing investments.
In this role, you will lead a high-performing team of Applied Scientists working at the intersection of causal inference, machine learning, modern AI, and marketing technology. Partnering directly with Marketing, Media, Operations, and Engineering, you will build and deploy Uber’s next-generation marketing science stack—shaping multi-million dollar decisions in real time across our global business.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Translate Business to Science: Turn ambiguous business challenges into crisp scientific roadmaps, structured experiment plans, and actionable analytical frameworks.
Build the Experimentation Stack: Lead our core measurement engine. Build and scale geo-experiments, conversion lift studies, and synthetic controls to establish the scientific "ground truth" for marketing efficiency.
Triangulate Measurement: Complement experimental lift with Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and multi-touch/algorithmic attribution, calibrating observational models directly against experimental results.

3+ years of direct people management experience building and leading science teams.
Exceptional executive communication skills—able to make complex statistical concepts intuitive for business and executive stakeholders.
Demonstrated track record of translating broad business objectives into concrete scientific strategy and technical deliverables.
Deep expertise in causal inference and experimentation at scale (e.g., geo-experiments, conversion lift, synthetic controls, quasi-experiments).
Strong foundation in machine learning, predictive modeling, and applied AI in enterprise environments.
Proficiency in Python, SQL, modern AI/ML frameworks, and big data technology.

Ph.D. or M.S. in Statistics, Econometrics, Economics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.
5+ years of domain experience in AdTech/MarTech, media optimization, and digital ad platforms (e.g., Meta, Google, TikTok, Programmatic).
Proven experience scaling automated geo-testing engines or custom conversion lift frameworks across complex media channels.
Hands-on experience using experimental ground truth to calibrate tools like Marketing Mix Models (MMM) and attribution algorithms.

End to end product development from data, analytics, modeling and experimentation perspective. Design and analyze experiments, present results that provide actionable recommendations.

Owning the product development cycle end to end from data and science aspects.

Design experiments and interpret the results to draw detailed and actionable conclusions across a variety of key performance indicators

Ph.D. in Economics, Statistics, Machine Learning, Operations Research or other quantitative fields.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills: Able to lead initiatives across multiple product areas and communicate findings with leadership and product teams

Experience in large-scale marketplace algorithm design, membership / consumer growth, or experimentation platform.
Experience with exploratory data analysis, statistical analysis and model development
Strong programming skills to prototype models in at least one of Python (preferably), R, Java, Go, Scala

About the Role
We are looking for a senior leader to own the Data Trust and Governance on Data Infrastructure and Strategy (DI&S) team within Uber’s Customer Advocacy Solutions (CAS) organization. This role is critical to ensuring that our customer support data remains reliable, consistent, trusted, and fit for purpose as we scale support operations, modernize the data platform, and expand AI-driven fully self-service.
The person in this role will establish and drive governance standards across data quality, observability, lineage, metadata, metric definitions, semantic clarity, and full data context. They will work closely with engineering, analytics, product, operations, science and AI stakeholders to ensure customer support data is correct, aggregated and explainable for human users, while also being connected, contextual, timely, and grounded for AI systems.
This is a high-impact data leadership role at the intersection of product, engineering and AI. Success in this role requires building trust in data for both traditional governance outcomes and the next generation of agentic AI analytics readiness.
What You Will Do:
Data Quality & Trust: Establish and enforce high data quality and trust standards, making quality the default expectation and measurably proven through data, not assumed.
Analytics & AI Data Foundation: Govern the shared canonical data foundation powering trusted analytics and AI.
Data Observability: Establish observability, freshness, and reliability standards with effective system controls to proactively detect issues and consistently meet defined data contract and SLAs.
Master Data & Semantics: Govern master data, metadata, business definitions, semantics, context and ontology for consistent human and AI consumption.
Metrics & Lineage: Govern metric definitions, lineage, and source traceability so root-cause analysis and drill-down from reported metrics to underlying facts are available by default.
AI Readiness: Establish and enforce analytics- and AI-ready data standards for reliable agentic AI and analytics.
Governance & Adoption: Establish clear ownership, stewardship, accountability, and adoption of governance standards.
Shift-Left Governance: Embed governance, quality, observability, and AI-readiness requirements into data design and modernization.
Basic Qualifications
Minimum 5 years of experience in an analytics-focused role with experience in extracting insights from data and summarizing key findings and takeaways
Bachelors Degree in Math, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering or related quantitative fields
Experience establishing and operationalizing at least two of the core data governance functions: data quality, data observability, data lineage or metadata management, master data management and metrics governance at enterprise level.
Preferred Qualifications
10+ years of experience in an analytics-focused role with experience in extracting insights from data and summarizing key findings and takeaways
Masters Degree in Math, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering or related quantitative fields
Experience establishing data governance and trust for AI/ML and agentic AI, including standards for machine-consumable, contextual, grounded, and evaluation data.
Experience with canonical data modeling, event and state modeling, identity resolution, and end-to-end journey data supporting both analytics and AI.
Experience embedding shift-left governance into large-scale data modernization, cloud platforms, source instrumentation, and data engineering practices.
Practical understanding of LLMs, AI agents, retrieval, copilots, and AI-driven workflows, particularly the data foundations required to make them reliable.
Experience applying modern data governance in customer support or similarly complex operational domains, where data connects customer journeys, automation, human workflows, and business outcomes.
Experience working knowledge of metadata, master data, business semantics, metric governance, data lineage, and source traceability.
Experience leading cross-functional data governance programs, establish ownership and accountability, and communicate effectively with technical, business, and executive stakeholders.
Experience establishing and operationalizing data quality, trust, observability, data SLAs, issue management, and governance controls at scale.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, and SQL with proven ability to write and understand complex queries.

About the role
The Policy Economics team conducts external research that forms the foundation for Uber’s policy positions and helps policymakers, thought leaders, and the general public gain a better understanding of our platform. We also conduct internal research that supports strategic decisions, helping leadership to weigh complex trade-offs across competitive, legal, operational, and product considerations.
Serving as a bridge between policy experts and technical teams, we help the policy team deliver principled advice to product teams and arming policy leads with an understanding of the economics of Uber’s marketplace. Our work spans the full spectrum — from internal analytical deep dives, to rapid-response analyses on high-profile policy issues, to multi-year research collaborations with external partners that build public understanding of the platform economy.
Responsibilities
Conduct rigorous, careful statistical and econometric analysis in service of our policy priorities, particularly on topics relating to drivers and couriers, marketplace dynamics, and core technology such as matching and pricing.
Partner with in-country policy teams to develop research that speaks to their local contexts.
Develop deep cross-functional relationships with product, legal, and operations to ensure alignment between policy and business strategy.
Manage relationships with our external research partners to ensure research collaborations run smoothly.

5+ years of professional industry experience as an Applied Scientist, Data Scientist, Economist, or equivalent (or 3+ years with a Ph.D.)
Strong data skills and experience with tools such as SQL, Python, and R to work efficiently at scale.

Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to synthesize research results into clear, actionable insights accessible to broad audiences.

PhD in Economics.

Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with ability to collaborate cross-functionally and translate technical findings for non-technical audiences.
Ability to proactively identify research questions relevant to business or policy.
Project management skills and experience working in a cross-functional environment with legal, policy, and business leaders.
Passion for Uber’s mission and for helping shape fair, transparent narratives about drivers, couriers, customers, and marketplace dynamics.

Senior Product Designer, Autonomous Mobility & Delivery Experience
Autonomous vehicles are reshaping how people and goods move through cities. At Uber, we're building the experiences that make autonomous mobility feel intuitive, trustworthy, and seamlessly integrated into everyday life.
As a Product Designer on the Autonomous Mobility & Delivery Experience team, you'll define the future of how riders discover, understand, request, and complete autonomous trips. You'll work across the end-to-end journey, turning emerging technology into experiences that millions of people can confidently use.
This is a 0-to-1 environment where you must make big decisions without perfect information and own the outcomes. You’ll need to navigate high-stakes ambiguity, balance near-term execution with long-term vision, and advocate for the user in a high-speed, technical landscape. If you think critically and are motivated by the challenge of real-world impact at a global scale, this is where you will grow.
What You'll Do
Design end-to-end experiences across the autonomous rider journey, from discovery and booking through pickup, ride, support, and beyond.
Shape product strategy alongside Product, Engineering, Operations, Research, Data Science, and partner teams.
Translate complex technical capabilities and operational constraints into simple, intuitive customer experiences.
Build trust by designing experiences that help riders understand what autonomous vehicles are doing, what to expect, and how to interact with them.
Develop scalable interaction patterns and frameworks that can support multiple autonomous vehicle partners and future capabilities.
Prototype and communicate ideas quickly to drive alignment and accelerate decision making.
Use research, experimentation, and data to continuously improve the rider experience.
Raise the quality bar through systems thinking, strong craft, and thoughtful design execution.
Basic qualifications
5+ years of professional product design experience, with a proven track record of shipping, scaling, and iterating on high-quality consumer products.
A portfolio demonstrating strategic thinking alongside exceptional design craft.
Strong product thinking with the ability to balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints.
Demonstrated proficiency with AI-first design workflows, alongside exceptional interaction design, visual design, and prototyping skills.
Strong communication and storytelling skills with cross-functional partners and leadership and experience influencing product strategy beyond individual features.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with transportation, mapping, mobility, logistics, robotics, or AI-powered products.
Experience building and implementing components within a global, scalable design system.
Experience designing physical-digital experiences, including automotive HMI, in-vehicle experiences, or other connected products.
Proven ability to collaborate with user researchers and data scientists to drive experimentation and A/B testing.
Deep expertise in AI-native design workflows and complex technical prototyping, including building custom tools, agents, and production-ready implementations.
Why Join This Team
Autonomous mobility represents one of the biggest shifts in transportation in decades. You'll have the opportunity to define experiences that don't yet have industry standards, influence how millions of people interact with autonomous technology, and help shape the future of mobility on a global scale.

uber-147707.text:
About the Role
As an A/V Engineer at Uber, you will play a pivotal role in architecting, implementing, and supporting advanced A/V systems across our global office footprint. Sitting within the Digital Experience team, you will apply your technical acumen and engineering discipline to design, configure, test, and optimize A/V solutions that meet the evolving needs of a hybrid workforce and high-impact collaboration environments.
This is a hands-on engineering role requiring advanced scripting/configuration skills, architectural design fluency, and the ability to troubleshoot and maintain high-reliability A/V environments. You will work cross-functionally with Product Managers, IT, Workplace, and third-party vendors to ensure seamless A/V system performance, contributing to engineering excellence through robust documentation, mentoring, and operational rigor.
What the Candidate Will Do
Design and implement scalable and high-performing A/V solutions in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
Write, test, and maintain configuration scripts and automation to deploy and manage A/V systems across Uber offices.
Proactively monitor and improve A/V system reliability by building observability (alerts, telemetry, health dashboards) into production systems.
Participate in on-call rotations and respond to escalations, leveraging strong troubleshooting practices to minimize downtime.
Lead technical design discussions, develop architecture artifacts (e.g., system diagrams, ERDs), and define configuration standards.
Review peers’ configurations/scripts, provide constructive feedback, and raise the quality bar across the A/V Engineering team.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to internal documentation, onboarding guides, and operational runbooks to scale team knowledge.
Partner with Workplace, IT, and Product stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical A/V system designs.
Identify technical debt, propose solutions to optimize performance and reduce system complexity.
Represent A/V Engineering in internal forums, contribute to cultural and inclusion efforts (e.g., ERGs), and actively participate in the recruiting and interviewing process.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, A/V Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Proven experience engineering A/V systems in enterprise environments (conference rooms, boardrooms, auditoriums).
Proficiency in configuration/scripting (e.g., Crestron, Q-SYS, Extron, Zoom APIs, JSON, Python, JS, or equivalent tools).
Deep understanding of A/V control systems, video conferencing technologies, signal flow, audio processing, and A/V-over-IP.
Experience building and maintaining A/V monitoring and telemetry platforms (e.g., Zoom Dashboard, Logitech Sync, Crestron XiO Cloud).
Strong documentation skills, including runbooks, design wikis, and SOPs.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, especially when working with cross-functional teams and diverse stakeholders.
Experience leading system troubleshooting during incidents, with a focus on root cause analysis and long-term mitigation.
Preferred Qualifications
Certifications such as CTS, CTS-D, Crestron Programmer, Q-SYS Level 2, or equivalent.
Experience with A/V infrastructure in multi-site, global deployments.
Familiarity with ticketing and configuration management systems (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow, Git).
Ability to manage A/V integrators and contractors during buildouts and retrofits.
Experience developing testing frameworks and implementing CI/CD pipelines for A/V system configuration deployments.
Passion for mentoring and driving continuous improvement within engineering teams.
Familiarity with accessibility standards and designing inclusive A/V experiences.

uber-302588.text:
About the Role
As a Senior Security Technologist on Uber’s Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) team, you will help operate, engineer, and transform Uber’s TPRM program. You will help ensure third-party security risks are effectively identified, assessed, monitored, and managed across Uber’s global vendor ecosystem while building the technology and automation needed to operate the program at scale.
This role requires an automation-first, engineering mindset. You will approach operational and risk challenges by first asking how they can be solved through code, automation, AI, better data, or system integrations, rather than adding manual processes. You will be expected to prototype and build solutions yourself, automate repeatable work, and partner with engineering teams on larger capabilities that fundamentally improve how third-party risk is managed.
You will also serve as a lead for day-to-day TPRM operations. You will oversee our managed service provider (MSP), manage escalations and complex vendor issues, support third-party security incidents, and partner across Engineering Security, Legal, Privacy, Procurement, and business teams to drive appropriate risk decisions. You will use the problems, friction, and patterns you see in the program to identify what should be automated, redesigned, or eliminated.
You will help move TPRM beyond manual, point-in-time assessments toward a more automated, continuous, data-driven, and intelligence-led approach. This includes building automation and integrations, developing AI-assisted workflows and agents, improving the TPRM platform and data ecosystem, and bringing together internal and external security signals to enable faster and better risk decisions.
The ideal candidate is comfortable:
writing code and independently building automation, integrations, and technical solutions,
identifying manual processes and redesigning them through an automation-first approach,
leveraging AI and agentic workflows to solve security and operational problems,
leading day-to-day TPRM operations and managing escalations,
managing MSP delivery, quality, and performance,
assessing third-party security risk and technical security controls,
working directly with vendors to resolve complex security and risk issues,
supporting third-party security incidents and assessing potential impact,
managing and improving TPRM platforms, workflows, and data,
and communicating technical risk to leadership and business stakeholders.
You’ll be successful in this role if you can combine security risk expertise with hands-on technical execution—solving today’s operational challenges while continuously engineering better ways for TPRM to operate at scale.
What You'll Do
Build automation, tooling, agents, and integrations to solve TPRM problems, eliminate repetitive manual work, improve decision quality, and enable the program to scale
Write code and prototype solutions directly, using APIs, security and risk data, AI-assisted development, and other technologies to rapidly solve operational and risk management challenges
Identify recurring operational problems and determine where automation, AI, improved data, or redesigned workflows can replace manual processes
Lead day-to-day TPRM operations, including third-party security assessments, risk decisions, stakeholder and vendor escalations, and delivery against established service levels
Oversee TPRM managed service provider delivery and performance, including workload, quality, capacity, SLAs, issue resolution, and continuous improvement
Manage complex third-party security issues and work directly with vendors and internal stakeholders to evaluate risk, challenge responses, resolve gaps, and drive appropriate remediation or risk treatment
Support third-party security incidents by assessing Uber’s potential exposure, coordinating with relevant Engineering Security teams and vendors, and helping drive appropriate risk response
Manage and continuously improve TPRM platforms, workflows, integrations, data quality, and reporting, and partner with engineering teams on larger program transformation capabilities
Help evolve TPRM toward more continuous and intelligence-driven risk management by integrating security signals, automating assessments and monitoring, and identifying opportunities for program-wide transformation
Basic Qualifications
5+ years of experience in security engineering, third-party risk management, cloud security, infrastructure security, security assurance, security risk, or related technical security roles
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
Hands-on experience writing code and building automation using languages such as Python, Go, Bash, or similar, with the ability to translate manual or operational problems into scalable technical solutions
Experience building integrations and working with APIs, security tooling, automation platforms, and AI-assisted development workflows
Experience managing or supporting day-to-day third-party risk management or security assurance operations, including complex security and stakeholder escalations
Experience overseeing managed service providers, external delivery teams, or similar operational delivery models
Experience applying risk management principles, assessing technical security controls, and evaluating security evidence across modern cloud, SaaS, and enterprise environments
Understanding of:
cloud infrastructure and security
identity and access management
endpoint security
vulnerability management
logging and telemetry systems
enterprise SaaS platforms
networking fundamentals
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and security risk clearly to technical teams, vendors, business stakeholders, and leadership
Comfort navigating ambiguity, managing escalations, and independently solving technical and operational problems in fast-moving environments
Preferred Qualifications
Strong experience in Third-Party Risk Management, vendor security, or security assurance
Experience leading or managing TPRM operations at scale
Experience managing MSP performance, including quality, capacity, SLAs, and operational metrics
Experience supporting third-party security incidents and evaluating organizational exposure to vendor incidents or vulnerabilities
Experience administering, configuring, or helping manage TPRM, GRC, or security workflow platforms
Experience building internal security tooling, agents, workflow automation, or operational automation platforms
Experience designing integrations across security systems and data sources using APIs and automated workflows
Experience using LLMs or AI tooling to build or significantly improve security analysis, assessment, or TPRM workflows
Strong investigative, problem-solving, written communication, and program management skills
Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities for process improvement and translate them into practical technical solutions
Ability to balance hands-on technical execution, day-to-day operations, and longer-term program transformation

uber-303734.text:
We are seeking a strategic and operationally-minded Manager of People Solutions & Knowledge to lead the digital front door of our People team. You will be the functional owner of the ServiceNow platform for HR, ensuring that our technology, content, and data insights work in harmony to support our global workforce.
You will lead a specialized team acting as the primary bridge between the People team’s requirements and our Technical/IT partners. Your goal is to move beyond traditional case management toward an AI-enabled, knowledge-first service model where employees find answers effortlessly and leadership has the data to make proactive decisions.
Key Responsibilities
Serve as the primary People Team lead for the ServiceNow (HRSD) platform. You own the relationship with the IT/Technical teams to translate HR process needs into platform reality.
Manage the intake and prioritization of ServiceNow enhancements, ensuring the platform evolves to meet the changing needs of a global People team.
Drive the functional setup and optimization of AI features, ensuring the platform is configured to provide predictive, high-quality responses to employees.
Lead a team of writers to create clear, intuitive, and action-oriented content. Ensure our Virtual Agent (Now Assist) is fueled by accurate, high-quality knowledge that resolves issues before they reach a human
Define the global strategy for how information is structured, tagged, and delivered, ensuring our Tier 0 self-service is the most effective way for employees to get help.
Lead a Data Analyst to build and maintain sophisticated ServiceNow dashboards that track more than just volume. Measure knowledge effectiveness, automation ROI, and employee sentiment.
Collaborate with other departments that use ServiceNow to ensure a unified employee experience across the company.
Partner with our COEs team to ensure any new program or policy is launched with the right knowledge articles and workflows ready on Day 1.
The Ideal Profile
You understand how a change in a knowledge article impacts AI resolution and how a data field in ServiceNow impacts downstream payroll or IT access.
You have a high bar for content and understand that clear communication reduces the need for human intervention.
You are skilled at managing the relationship with technical teams—you know how to define What you need so they can build the How.
Basic Qualifications
5 years in People Operations, HR Technology, or Service Management.
Proven experience managing ServiceNow (HRSD) or similar system, from a functional perspective.
3 years experience leading people
Preferred Qualifications
Ability to manage a roadmap and influence stakeholders across HR and IT.
Comfortable interpreting complex dashboards to drive operational changes.
Prior experience managing content and optimizing for high case deflection

About the Role
In Finance, we work hand-in-hand with leaders across the company to support disciplined execution of our strategic business objectives. Our Strategic Finance team provides financial insights through business partnering, forecasting, budgeting, and financial analysis.
As an Associate on the Strategic Finance team , you will support key financial planning and analysis activities for our Platform Engineering organization. This role is highly analytical and modeling-intensive. You will work with Finance and cross-functional partners to translate business questions into structured financial analyses and scalable models that support planning and decision-making.
We are looking for someone with exceptional financial modeling and analytical skills —someone who can take a business problem, identify the key inputs and assumptions, determine the appropriate outputs, and build a robust and scalable financial model from the ground up.
What You'll Do
Build Scalable Financial Models: Design and build financial models from scratch, identifying the appropriate inputs, assumptions, drivers, calculations, and outputs needed to answer business questions.
Translate Problems into Analytical Frameworks: Take complex or ambiguous business questions and structure them into clear, quantitative analyses.
Forecasting & Planning: Build and maintain driver-based forecasting and planning models, including scenario and sensitivity analyses.
Financial Analysis: Analyze financial and operational data to understand key cost drivers, trends, variances, and trade-offs.
Improve Existing Models: Evaluate and enhance existing financial models to improve accuracy, scalability, automation, and ease of use.
Reporting & Insights: Translate model outputs and financial analyses into clear insights for Finance and business stakeholders.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work with Finance, Accounting, and business partners to source and validate model inputs, understand actuals, and ensure consistency of financial data.
Basic Qualifications
BS/BA in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Engineering, or another quantitative field.
2 years of relevant experience in FP&A, investment banking, consulting, corporate finance, or another highly analytical role.
Preferred Qualifications
Exceptional Excel and/or Google Sheets skills, with demonstrated experience building complex financial models from scratch.
Strong understanding of financial modeling principles, including driver-based forecasting, scenario analysis, sensitivities, and model architecture .
Ability to independently structure an analytical problem by identifying the required inputs, assumptions, calculations, and outputs .
Strong quantitative and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
Ability to build models that are accurate, dynamic, scalable, and easy for others to understand and maintain .
Ability to synthesize complex analyses into clear financial insights and communicate them effectively.
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $106,000 per year - USD $118,000 per year.

About the role and team
We’re hiring a Senior Product Designer for the Uber Direct & Connect on-demand delivery team. Uber Direct & Connect helps both consumers and SMBs get anything delivered, from dry cleaning drop-offs and retail returns to custom shopping lists and cross-country deliveries.
As a Senior Product designer for Uber Direct & Connect, you’ll help build one of Uber’s fastest-growing independent lines of business and will have the unique opportunity to work across three sides of the delivery marketplace, providing consumers and businesses around the world with access to our best-in-class logistics network. You’ll be responsible for defining the future of Connect, driving more affordable, flexible delivery options, and building features to accelerate our expansion to new markets.
What you’ll do
Lead human-centered experience design for high-impact domains, defining new interaction patterns and service models where none exist today.
Own design problems end-to-end, from early-stage research and conceptual wireframes to high-fidelity prototypes and final production-ready assets.
Partner as a key thought leader with Product, Engineering, and Operations to define requirements and shape the strategic roadmap, not just translate them into mocks.
Design across digital and physical touchpoints, translating complex logistical and technical systems into clear, intuitive flows for mobile, web, and vehicle interfaces.
Maintain and evolve Uber’s design language by contributing to shared systems and foundational patterns that ensure consistency across global platforms.
Prototype rapidly to test hypotheses and validate ideas early, using data and user research to iterate and raise the bar for quality and trustworthiness.
Basic Qualifications
5+ years of professional product design experience, with a track record of shipping successful digital products for mobile and web.
A portfolio showcasing high-quality design work, strong systems thinking, and a deep understanding of user-centered design principles.
Proficiency with Figma and a range of prototyping tools to bring complex ideas to life.
Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity and lead design direction in fast-paced, evolving environments.
Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale to technical and non-technical audiences.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in frontier or complex domains such as Autonomous Systems, AdTech, Fintech, or Enterprise/Operational tools.
Experience designing across physical and digital touchpoints, including geospatial or location-aware systems.
Proven ability to collaborate with user researchers and data scientists to drive experimentation and A/B testing.
Advanced degree in HCI, Interaction Design, Industrial Design, or a related field.
Experience building and implementing components within a global, scalable design system.
